author: Access Now
title: From surveillance to governance: recentering human rights in the UN AI agenda
content:
September 21


				 @


				9:00 am


					 –


					10:30 am


EDT


Hybrid side event during UNGA81 High-Level Week


Venue:

 WeWork, 1460 Broadway, New York, NY, 10036, Boardroom 12C (12th Floor)


 Add to Calendar


 Google


 Apple


 Outlook 365


 Outlook Live


Panelists:


Louise Lund Henneberg

, Acting Director/Techplomacy, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Denmark


Wafa Ben Hassine

, Chief, Digital Technology and Human Rights Section, Rule of Law,


Accountability and Civic Space

, Oﬀice of the High Commissioner for Human Rights


Beatriz Busaniche

, Executive Director, Fundación Vía Libre


Luda Svystunova

, Head of Social Research, Amundi


Moderator:


Alejandro Mayoral Baños

, Co-Executive Director, Access Now


During the first session of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance, governments and stakeholders convened to have open, transparent and inclusive discussions on artificial intelligence governance. We now gather experts across the spectrum of stakeholders during UNGA81 to reaffirm that human rights should be the stepping stone of this process, instead of an afterthought.


None of this is irreversible, but the security issues associated with advanced AI tools are the consequences of deliberately prioritizing profit and competitiveness over the security and safety of at-risk communities, and they will not resolve on their own. Unbridled AI adoption combined with unacceptably lax corporate security practices demands urgent intervention at all levels, starting from putting human rights back at the center of digital governance mechanisms.


This discussion has the objective to explore concrete, actionable ways in which each stakeholder can contribute to oppose the normalization of surveillance. Experts will also discuss how to chart a way forward to reaffirm digital rights as the natural first line of defense against the abuses of AI technologies.

author: CNT Galiza
title: La Inspección de Trabajo da la razón a la CNT y destapa fraude en las cotizaciones de Forbe Multimedia
content:
El ITSS emite un acta de liquidación por valor de más de 10.000 euros contra la empresa por diferencias e irregularidades en las cotizaciones durante un periodo de un año y medio.


Nueva victoria para el sindicalismo de clase y la acción sindical de la CNT Galicia. La Inspección Provincial de Trabajo y Seguridad Social de A Coruña ha estimado categóricamente la denuncia presentada por nuestra central sindical contra la empresa FORBE MULTIMEDIA SLU.


Mediante resolución oficial, el organismo estatal confirmó la existencia de graves infracciones en materia de Seguridad Social. Como resultado de la investigación iniciada por la CNT, el ITSS procedió a elaborar un acta de liquidación de cuotas y el correspondiente acta de infracción contra la empresa.


Un año y medio de irregularidades al descubierto


La resolución detalla un importante descubierto en materia de cotizaciones a la Seguridad Social, desempleo, FOGASA y formación profesional, que se extendió ininterrumpidamente desde noviembre de 2023 hasta abril de 2025. Durante este periodo de dieciocho meses, FORBE MULTIMEDIA incurrió en prácticas de cotización insuficiente y discrepancias en la declaración de las bases de afiliación de sus trabajadores.


El importe total reclamado por la Inspección de Trabajo asciende a 10.020,19 euros. Esta cantidad incluye el capital de la deuda acumulada, más el recargo del 20%, aplicado directamente a la empresa por la gravedad y la demora en el cumplimiento de sus obligaciones legales.


La CNT, a la vanguardia en la defensa de los derechos laborales


Este caso demuestra una vez más la importancia de la autoorganización y la denuncia colectiva a través del sindicato. Lo que las empresas suelen intentar disfrazar como «errores administrativos» o prácticas habituales del sector, la Inspección lo ha calificado abiertamente como un descubierto formal que vulnera los derechos más básicos de los trabajadores en lo que respecta a sus prestaciones presentes y futuras.


Si te roban en tu salario o tus contribuciones, no te quedes callado. ¡Organízate en la CNT!

title: OCD Rebellion - Towards an Anarchist Critical Theory of OCD
content:
Author

: OCD Rebellion

Title

: Towards an Anarchist Critical Theory of OCD

Subtitle

: Synthesizing an Anarchist OCD

Date

: 4th September

Source

: Retrieved on 4th September


 Looking on the anarchist library there is nothing specifically related to OCD. Ugh…. Same as a few years ago, while there is a lot of criticism of psychiatry and diagnostic logics used to pathologise and often otherise and exclude folks, what is not talked about in detail is specifically OCD, which stands for Obsessive Compulsive Disorder and how it relates to the anti authoritarian and no hierarchical ideology, milieu and ‘state’ of social formation called anarchism, anarchists and an-arche. In terms of. General academic theory there has been an attempt by writers Matthew Hiller and Eva Stepney called “The Paradox of Purity” pointing out certain guidelines for what could make a useful approach to critical theory. It touches on themes and thinkers that I also found relevant such as Mary Douglas and her work on purity, pollution, ritual and dirt such as found in the classic text “Purity and Danger,” in 1966. While I fine essay in and of itself what I often think is a missing thread not only in this article but in larger radical (and even “anarchist”) discussions is the usage of anarchist theory and thinkers which can locate key concerns in not only the phenomenology of OCD but in cultural conceptions which can make it a cross match for critical analysis.


OCD is Dis-Order? Anarchy is Order?


 A lot of critical theories as well as more poststructural theories are about challenging binaries and things which structure and control our life whether of normality, rationality of even concepts of order, chaos and control. As stated in the aforementioned article a Critical OCD approach looks to challenge binaries of Order/Chaos, similar binaries that are crucial to contemporary, social and historical conceptions of anarchy. Anarchist parlance has had a long history with playing between anarchism and its association with chaos, violence and disorder. Anselme Bellagarigue has the famous quote “Anarchy is order, government is civil war,” with the famous anarchist emblem painting the anarchist A over an O to symbolise in avarice to hegemonic notions that anarchy is in line with harmony order. While some anarchists have thought to recuperate anarchism from negative notions of chaos, messiness and disorder some anarchists have embraced it such as Enzo Martucci in an essay titled “In praise of chaos” who gave chaos a new meaning to signify non conformity, flux and freedom.


 Order is a weird term taking on multiple associations, some metaphorical, some societal and some even at the micro and even visual scale. An example of this is the anarchist inspired writer James C Scott and his use of the visual in Seeing Like a State to elucidate “Visual and aesthetic” order (A supposes characteristic of Authoritarian High Modernism). OCD can be contrasted to order in many ways but in this section it is interesting to look at the often found label “symmetry/Order” OCD with OCD finding heavy cultural concepts with psychotic levels of neatness, harmony and visual unity with “Im so OCD” often referring to a need to have things in just the right order, so precise as to try to reach absolute perfection. As Meaghan Rice of TalkSPace says “ Symmetry and Ordering OCD is a subtype of OCD causes a person to focus excessively on how things look or are arranged, balanced, or positioned.”


 This leads to distress if the compulsions or actions to neaten, balance, position or order/perfect things aren’t done “correctly. While this is just one aspect of OCD it is to note that there has been work with OCD in disability studies regarding order. As the writers of The paradox of Purity put it, “Disability studies scholars have challenged medicalized and individualized accounts of OCD, arguing that the disorder is instead a symptom of modernity, in which individuals over-internalize social imperatives towards order and control (Davis 11; Castel 302; Fleissner 34). To this end, they present OCD as a constructed category that pathologizes thoughts and behavior that are deemed as excessive or unproductive, with treatment acting to discipline non-normative ways of being.” While not cited in the article, this passage is similar to the one found in “The philosophy of Dirt” on page 126 echoing the work of Norbert Elias in “The Civilising Mission,” in which the early modern period is …

title: Kundgebung: Iraner*innen fordern mehr Klarheit von Beat Jans und dem SEM
content:
Heute ab 12 Uhr demonstrieren abgewiesene Iraner*

innen vor dem Staatssekretariat für Migration (SEM) in Wabern. Die Kundgebung wird von der Gruppe Empathie und Einheit organisiert. Kritisiert werden Beat Jans und das SEM, die die verallgemeinerte Gewalt im Iran nicht genügend klar anerkennen. Dies führt für Iraner

*

innen in der Schweiz zu einschneidenden und weitreichenden Problemen.


«Die Vogel-Strauss-Politik muss ein Ende haben.»


 (Empathie und Einheit

)


Die Sicherheitslage im Iran sei unübersichtlich.

 So lautet die unbefriedigende Einschätzung von Bundesrat und SEM seit Anfangs dieses Jahres. Ausschaffungen in den Iran wurden deshalb zwar sistiert, jedoch nicht eindeutig als unzumutbar, unzulässig und/oder unmöglich eingestuft. Gemäss dem Asylgesetz liegt es an Beat Jans, sich hierzu politisch zu positionieren. Falls die Lage im Iran einer Situation allgemeiner Gewalt entspricht, müsste den insgesamt knapp 300 abgewiesenen Iraner*innen mindestens eine vorläufige Aufnahme gewährt werden.


Es ist die neunte monatliche Kundgebung vor dem SEM.

 Die abgewiesenen Iraner*innen engagieren sich für eine Asylpraxisänderung, die den Schutz iranischer Asylsuchender in der Schweiz verbessert. Mit diesem Ziel begannen Iraner*innen gestern auf dem Bundesplatz einen Hungerstreik, nachdem es bereits im Juli in Zürich zu einem

einwöchigen Sitzstreik

 kam. Damals wurde ein

offener Brief

 mit Forderungen an Bundesrat Jans und das SEM geschickt. Dieser blieb bisher jedoch unbeantwortet.


15.9.2026: Hungerstreik auf dem Bundesplatz.


Der Iran ist kein sicheres Land.

 Die Angriffe der israelischen und der US-amerikanischen Armee sowie die zunehmende Repression durch das iranische Regime führen im Iran zu einer Situation allgemeiner Gewalt. Diese trifft die gesamte Bevölkerung.

Die Schweizerische Flüchtlingshilfe kommt deshalb zum Schluss, dass abgewiesenen Iraner*innen mindestens eine vorläufige Aufnahme zustehen würde

.


Juli 2026: Sitzstreik in Zürich.


Die Berichte über die Lage im Iran sind eindeutig.

Hier nur einige neuere Beispiele:


Am 3. September 2026 kritisierte die UN-Fact-Finding-Mission für den Iran

 ein geplantes Gesetz, das dazu führen würde, dass iranische Medienschaffende, Forschende und politisch Aktive zu Freiheitsstrafen von bis zu 30 Jahren verurteilt werden können, wenn sie Kontakt mit ausländischen Medien, NGOs oder Universitäten haben.


Am 6. August 2026 kritisierten UN-Expert*innen

, dass das iranische Regime eine eskalierende Praxis willkürlicher Inhaftierungen, des Verschwindenlassens von Personen, der Folter und anderer Misshandlungen sowie willkürlicher Hinrichtungen von Angehörigen ethnischer Minderheiten, insbesondere der kurdischen und belutschischen Minderheiten, anordne.


Am 28. Juli 2026 kritisierte Amnesty International

, dass das iranische Regime mit einer erschreckenden Welle von Hinrichtungen und Todesurteilen vorgehe, um abweichende Meinungen zu bestrafen und zu unterdrücken sowie nach dem Aufstand im Januar und angesichts der anhaltenden Angriffe durch die USA und Israel ein Bild absoluter Kontrolle zu vermitteln.


Empathie und Einheit organisiert etwa einen Drittel aller abgewiesenen Iraner*innen in der Schweiz.

 Die meisten von ihnen sind vor mehr als fünf Jahren in die Schweiz geflüchtet. Aufgrund eines negativen Asylentscheids sind sie auf unbegrenzte Zeit blockiert. Als Nothilfebezüger*innen wird ihnen Prekarität aufgezwungen. Sie müssen von lediglich 10 Franken pro Tag leben und werden an freiheitsbeschränkenden Orten ohne Privatsphäre untergebracht. Sie dürfen zudem nicht arbeiten, haben kein Recht auf Bildung und nur einen eingeschränkten Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung und anderen Grundrechten.

Det är nu tjugo år sedan Olof Nordström kom till Mora, där han blev banbrytaren, den första socialisten.

Han var född den 20 juni 1851, således en fyratioårs man då han tog upp striden i det av gudsförnekelse och arbetarerörelse alldeles oberörda Mora.

Han rekvirerade hem Folkbladeto ch gick omkring och sålde. Till början gick det trögt, så småningom kunde han öka upplagan. Hade han många fiender, började dock arbetarna att förstå honom och i fackföreningen, avdel. 62, blev han år 1900 ordförande.

Få är det som fört en så intensiv agitation som Olof Nordström. Han var hängiven socialist och som han ej kände någon annan riktning därinom än socialdemokratin, blev det den han med ofantlig energi arbetade för. När han senare gjorde bekantskap med den revolutionära socialismen, omfattade han straxo ch egnade den alla sina krafter. Nu blev det Brand, som Olof Nordström, till Moraboarnas stora förskräckelse, började att sprida. Hade man förut sett på honom med oblida ögon, kastade man sig nu över honom. Det blev en hård strid för femtiåringen, men han höll i och besegrade alla hinder. Som Brands kommissionär, som han var ända tills för ett par år sedan, då han av trötthet och sjukdom var nödd att sluta, var han såsom i allt mycket energisk, tidigt och sent arbetande för dess spridning.

Sina värsta fiender hade han bland läsarpacket. De visste han var ateist och att han agiterade för att sprida upplysning och kunskap: den största synden. De hatade honom. Och då han nu, sextioåringen, ligger på dödsbädden, kunna de ej lämna honom i ro. En Mora-kamrat skriver till mig, att flera av läsarna voro hos den sjuke och ville omvända honom. Han plågades av deras smutsprat, och det var väl det de sågo och det gjorde dem glädje, ty sådana rackare äro de kristna. Vår gamle kamrat visade dem bort. Ända in i det sista fortsatte de dock med sitt misslyckade omvändelseverk; sista försöket gjordes av dem en halv timme innan han dog. Men de fingo gå med långa näsor! Han hade läst och tänkt för mycket, var alltför sann och uppriktig fritänkare och ateist att låta tillfällig stämning rubba hans övertygelse.

På eftermiddagen den 12 dennes hade han stridit slut och lade sitt trötta huvud till vila. Det var proletärsjukdomen, som bröt honom, bäddade hans grav.

Från de par gånger, jag besökt det vackra Mora, har jag ett kärt minne av den gamle stridskämpen och hans familj.

Den ungdomlige åldringen, som i alla sina dagar fått slita så hårt, var eld och flamma då det gällde möten och agitation. De revolutionära idéerna, som hans hustru, intelligent och vaken, omfattade med samma inträsse som han, voro honom så kära, hade trängt så in i blodet på honom att de voro honom heliga. Det gällde det största av allt: att få ett samhälle av medmänniskor, alltså utan fattigdom, utan förtryck. Visserligen blev han nog på äldre dagar litet tankeslö, och kunde ej med samma kraft känna hur all kompromiss förfuskar och smutsar; han vart försonligare stämd, undantagandes mot vidskepelsens får och lejda drängar. Vilken gemen roll religionen spelar i de fattigas förtryckande, det hade han för länge sedan insett, och styrktes i sin övertygelse med varje dag, som gick. Därför hatade han och avskydde den svarta fördummelseläran, allt till sin sista stund.

Mycket hade vår kamrat lidit för sina djärva åsikters skull och för att han inte kunde lära sig att hyckla. Han var i hela sitt liv en fattig man, som ansåg sig ha rätt att hålla sitt huvud lika högt för det.

En glädje var det att sitta i hans hem och lyssna till honom och till hans hustru, då de berättade om vad de mäst gå igenom för att de ej kunde krypa, inte kunde tiga, eller då de sjöngo ut med sina innersta tankar och meningar, så revolutionära i grund och botten.

title: Dutch cops have killed another black man.
content:
Dutch cops have killed another black man.

On 12 September 2026

Juan Alfredo Goeloe

and his 7-month pregnant wife were holding a baby shower in Rotterdam when Juan left by bike to retrieve his medication. On his way he was stopped by police who claimed they were looking for a bike thief. He was detained because he did not carry an ID card. Eyewitnesses report that 7 cops sat on top of Juan while he screamed for help, that he was diabetic and that he couldn’t breath. Eventually he stopped moving. He died within walking distance of the baby shower where his wife was waiting for him to cut the cake.

author: none
title: Ronald Reed denied parole again.
content:
Write Ron and show him some support:

Ronald Reed #219531

Minnesota Correctional Facility – Lino Lakes

PO Box 247

Phoenix, MD 21131


Board again denies parole for man convicted in 1970 murder of officer James Sackett Sr.


Minnesota’s Supervised Release Board has again denied parole to a man convicted in the ambush murder of St. Paul Police Officer James Sackett Sr. The board’s meeting on Friday marked the fourth time that Ronald Reed, 76, appealed for his release.


Julie Sackett was 14 months old on May 22, 1970 when a sniper’s bullet killed her father. She was too young to remember him.


“All I have is photos,” Sackett said in a phone interview with MPR News on Friday.


Officer Sackett had responded to an emergency call about a pregnant woman in distress at Hague Avenue and Victoria Street, about a half mile from the governor’s residence, but there was no emergency.


Investigators said that Ronald Reed had lain in wait with a .30-caliber rifle and fired at Sackett from across the street. Prosecutors said that Reed, who is Black, wanted to impress the national leadership of the Black Panthers by killing a white police officer.


The case sat dormant for decades until reporting by KSTP-TV led investigators to reopen it. In 2006, a Ramsey County jury

convicted

 Reed of first-degree murder and conspiracy.


A judge sentenced Reed to life in prison, but because he was tried under the law in place at the time of the killing, Reed became eligible for parole after serving less than 17 years.


The Sackett family did not have the opportunity to testify at the Friday hearing. But Julie Sackett said that each time Reed is up for parole, they and hundreds of their law enforcement allies write letters to urge the board to keep him incarcerated.


“I don’t think that it’s fair that anyone that murders somebody should ever be released from prison, let alone a police officer,” Sackett said. “In this case, he murdered a police officer by ambush, lured them to the scene of the crime, and shot them on purpose.”


With one of the five members absent, the board deadlocked 2-2 on Corrections Commissioner Paul Schnell’s motion to deny Reed parole. Under the board’s rules, Schnell broke the tie.


Speaking by video link from the Lino Lakes prison, Reed called the move political; Schnell said the Sackett family’s wishes drove his decision.


“Can you tell me why you’re taking this hard-line position?” Reed asked.


“I think I made it clear my position, and it was victim and public sentiment,” Schnell replied.


Ronald Reed appears before a meeting in St. Paul of Minnesota’s Supervised Release Board by video link from the Lino Lakes prison.Screenshot via video


While Julie Sackett, her mother, siblings and other family members watched the hearing by video, many of Reed’s supporters appeared in person.


Melvin Carter II, a retired St. Paul police officer and father of former Mayor Melvin Carter III, was among them. The elder Carter is a rare voice in the law enforcement community calling for Reed’s freedom.


One of the department’s

first Black officers

, Carter joined the force several years after the murder. He’s known Reed since grade school. After Friday’s hearing, Carter said that his friend is no threat to public safety and has changed for the better.


“When that crime happened, he was 19 years old,” Carter said. “It’s time to let him go. In terms of being a burden on taxpayers, how much does it cost to keep a person in prison now? We’re just keeping him in there because we gotcha. And that’s what the system has done to Black people forever.”


Carter also questions whether Reed got a fair trial; Reed maintains his innocence.


The Minnesota Supreme Court

reversed

 the murder conviction of Reed’s co-defendant Larry Clark in 2008. Clark later reached a

plea deal

 with prosecutors on a less serious charge and was released.


Sackett said that her large extended family, which now includes many nieces, nephews, and grandchildren, will never let her father’s legacy fade.


“My father was a kind man, a loving man. He loved the community, and that’s why he responded to this phone call. He responded to this call to help a woman in distress. And what did he get, and what did we get? A life sentence,” Sackett said.


Reed’s next chance to petition for his release is in early 2028. Sackett said that she and her family will keep fighting to keep him in prison.

title: Essai d'ouverture
content:
C'est souvent le cas en période électorale et ça l'est probablement davantage au vu de la montée en puissance fascisante : tout est suspendu, le bon sens, le réel, l'audace, l'autonomie, la détermination. À la place, on sonde, on calcule, on se chuchote des petits secrets à l'oreille et l'on éructe des postures qui sonnent faux. Tout le monde pense manipuler tout le monde, mais c'est toujours avec le réel que l'on magouille. L'auteur de ce texte propose d'examiner ce que charrie cette appétence pour la stratégie politicienne. Spoiler : toute la logique d'un monde qu'elle prétend critiquer.


Toute stratégie politique, de quelque bord qu'elle soit, part de deux hypostases majeures : le sujet souverain et l'appareil d'État. De quelque côté qu'elle soit, elle suggère une intervention depuis l'extérieur vers le dedans des structures. Qu'elles veuillent éviter le déclin de la race blanche ou conjurer le fascisme qui arrive, les stratégies politiques reposent sur la même fiction éculée : le

sujet

 – politique. Que leurs fins soient inversées ne change rien à leur forme. L'une hait ce que l'autre défend, mais toutes deux somment un sujet de se lever, un peuple de se compter, une masse de se laisser conduire. Or il n'y a pas de sujet, pas plus que d'objet. Il y a des compositions, des décompositions, des recompositions, des vitesses. La stratégie, elle, impose cette grammaire : un sujet qui vise, qui calcule, qui se tient devant ; un objet qu'elle nomme, qu'elle fixe, qu'elle promet. La réalité, c'est qu'il n'y a pas de sujet politique qui se tient là, devant les structures qu'il prétend pouvoir modifier. Il y a une production singulière d'un contexte particulier : le sujet politique est une fable de l'État moderne autant que l'État moderne est un effet de cette fable – chacun a besoin de l'autre comme la rive le fleuve.


Alors les stratèges suggèrent que l'heure est grave, plus qu'avant, que jamais. Qu'au nom de toutes les existences précarisées, il faut se salir les mains, faire la retape pour les structures centenaires d'une république qui a massacré nos parents, grands-parents, arrière-grands-parents.

Au nom

, cela veut dire que ce n'est jamais depuis les massacres que ces voix s'élèvent ; mais depuis des estrades d'universités, depuis des entreprises fructueuses de bavardage sur Twitch, depuis des députations, depuis des maisons d'édition : depuis des intérêts très spécifiques dont les voix sont intelligibles. En cela, quels que soient les objectifs des différentes stratégies, leurs architectures sont analogues. Elles ont les mêmes points aveugles et reconduisent les mêmes structures. Elles suggèrent les mêmes modes d'action, les mêmes rapports au monde, à la masse –

Que faire des abstentionnistes ? Comment mobiliser les quartiers ? Faut-il abandonner la ruralité ?

Ainsi pris dans les mêmes représentations fallacieuses de l'État, du Peuple et du Pouvoir, les stratèges partagent la même obsession de l'administration des masses, avec des leviers plus ou moins ridicules, toujours plus paternalistes, encore trop didactiques. Car l'État est un mode de gouvernementalité dont l'axiome fondamental est la séparation : entre le sujet et l'objet, l'individu et le collectif, le public et le privé, le politique et le quotidien. Cette séparation, aussi fictionnelle soit-elle, produit des rapports, existe à travers eux. Partant de là, tout ce qui vise stratégiquement la conquête de l'appareil d'État ne peut prétendre être autre chose qu'une production issue des rapports codés et distribués par l'appareil d'État lui-même, et ne peut par conséquent engendrer autre chose que la continuation de ces rapports-là. Aussi révolutionnaire que soit la stratégie, elle fait tarder la révolution.


Ce qui fait varier le cours normal des choses, c'est moins les objectifs qu'on se donne pour faire advenir la variation que la pratique de la variation elle-même. Avoir comme mode d'agir la temporisation, l'attente en des dispositifs macro-politiques, la foi dans les institutions, cela

stabilise,

cela

 institue.

 Et ce qui institue conjure la variation, nécessairement : le poste et ce qui le brigue sont faits du même codage. Ce qui varie vraiment n'a pas de poste ; ce qui a un poste ne varie pas vraiment. Dans la forme donc, rien ne change d'avec l'ennemi : le meeting, le programme, le chef, la ferveur. Et tout est une question de forme. Le problème de l'État, c'est moins ses conséquences directes sur nos vies que la forme des rapports qu'il …

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 15 septembre
content:
Le 15 septembre de l'éphéméride des luttes à le mérite de poser des bases claires : 'la destruction de tout pouvoir politique est le premier devoir du prolétariat'. Alors que nous partons pour de nouvelles manifestations, souvenons-nous de ça.


1872 :

 A Saint-Imier en Suisse se tient le Congrès de la Fédération Jurassienne puis le Congrès des Sections et Fédérations antiautoritaires de l'Association Internationale des Travailleurs.


" Le Congrès réuni à Saint-Imier déclare :


 1° Que la destruction de tout pouvoir politique est le premier devoir du prolétariat ;

 2° Que toute organisation d'un pouvoir politique soi-disant provisoire et révolutionnaire pour amener cette destruction ne peut être qu'une tromperie de plus et serait aussi dangereuse pour le prolétariat que tous les gouvernements existants aujourd'hui ;

 3° Que, repoussant tout compromis pour arriver à l'accomplissement de la Révolution sociale, les prolétaires de tous pays doivent établir, en dehors de toute politique bourgeoise, la solidarité de l'action révolutionnaire."


1904 :

 A Milan, mort de l'anarchiste Angelo Galli, assassiné au début d'une grève générale en Italie. Selon

l'éphéméride anarchiste

, "

lors de ses funérailles de nouveaux affrontements avec la police se produiront auxquels assisteront le peintre Carlo Carrà qui immortalisera la scène dans un tableau réalisé en 1911 "Les funérailles de Galli l'anarchiste".


A l'origine de l'agitation sociale de septembre 1904, en Italie, les conditions de travail épouvantables des travailleurs et en particulier celles des mineurs à Buggerru en Sardaigne. Devant l'agravation de leurs conditions de travail, ils s'étaient mis en grève le 2 septembre. Le dimanche 4, alors que les mineurs étaient rassemblés devant le siège de la direction des mines pour appuyer la délégation syndicale qui était en négociations, la direction fit appel à l'armée. De Cagliari arrivent deux compagnie du 42e régiment d'infanterie qui tirent sur les grévistes faisant 4 morts et des dizaines de blessés. Cela provoque une vague d'indignations et de contestations à travers le pays qui commence par la Chambre du Travail de Milan. Divers rassemblements se produisent dans les jours suivant, réprimés aussitôt par la police. D'autres morts viennent s'ajouter à la liste comme à Castelluzzo en Sicile où deux paysans seront tués par l'armée. La contestation s'amplifia encore et finit à partir du 15 septembre par devenir une grève générale dans tout le pays. Elle atteindra son maximun le 19 septembre et ne cessera que le 21 au soir, avec l'engagement pris par le groupe socialiste de soumettre immédiatement au parlement un projet de loi visant à interdire l'utilisation des armes à feu par la police lors des conflits sociaux. L'attitude ambivalente du Pari Socialiste italien ne fera qu'exacerber l'antagonisme entre les politiciens opportunites et les révolutionnaires

." Le tableau dont il est question est l'image du jour.


1933 :

 A Barcelone, la CNT réunit un meeting de plus de 100.000 personnes et affirme la nécessité de faire la révolution.


1972 :

 A Bellver de Cerdanya, près d'Andorre, le MIL-GAC (Mouvement Ibérique de Libération – Groupes Autonomes de Combat) exproprie la Caisse d'Epargne, pour un butin d'un million de pesetas.


1979 :

 A Paris, attentats contre les intérêts patronaux dans la nuit d'une journée de négociation entre syndicats et patronat. Action armée revendiquée par Action Directe.


1981

 : En Allemagne, le commando Gudrun Ensslin de la Fraction Armée Rouge (RAF) dresse une embuscade contre le général Kroesen, commandant des forces terrestres US en Europe, mais la voiture blindée du général résiste à l'impact de la roquette antichar.


1982 :

 A Bochum, la RAF braque une banque.


2008 :

 Effondrement de la banque Lehman Brothers et début de la crise des subprimes. Pas longtemps après, les capitalistes disent que c'est la faute des Grec-que-s si l'économie va mal.


2016 :

 - Partout en France, nouvelle journée de mobilisation contre la Loi Travail et contre l'austérité. Parce qu'au final, ce n'étaient pas les Grec-que-s, c'est le capitalisme. Il va falloir faire mal.

Des affrontements se déroulent dans plusieurs villes

, notamment à Paris, où un policier prend feu.


 En Turquie, dans la région de Tendurek, la guérilla kurde attaque un poste de la contre-guérilla à l'aide d'armes automatiques et d'une roquette. 9 soldats sont tués.

author: Unknown
title: PISA 2025: Türkiye başarılı mı, başarısız mı?
content:
“PISA bir aynadır; önemli olan aynadaki görüntüyü beğenmek değil, gördüğümüz eksikleri gidermektir.”


Türkiye'nin PISA 2025 sonuçlarında önceki döneme göre önemli bir ilerleme göstermesi, eğitim kamuoyunda doğal olarak bir başarı göstergesi olarak değerlendirildi. Ancak bu sonucu yalnızca “Türkiye yükseldi, o hâlde eğitim sistemimiz başarılıdır” şeklinde yorumlamak ne kadar doğruysa, “Türkiye hâlâ dünyanın en başarılı ülkeleri arasında değil, o hâlde başarısızız” demek de aynı ölçüde eksik bir değerlendirmedir.


PISA sonuçlarını değerlendirirken öncelikle sıralama ile eğitim niteliği arasındaki farkı görmek gerekir.


PISA, 15 yaşındaki öğrencilerin matematik, fen ve okuma alanlarında sahip oldukları bilgi ve becerileri gerçek yaşam problemlerinde kullanabilme düzeylerini ölçüyor.. Dolayısıyla PISA önemli bir gösterge; ancak bir ülkenin eğitim sisteminin tamamını ölçen bir sınav değil.


Türkiye'nin 2025 sonuçlarında önceki döneme göre yükselmesi kuşkusuz dikkate değer bir gelişme. Özellikle öğrencilerin okuma ve fen becerilerindeki performansının OECD ortalamasıyla karşılaştırıldığında olumlu bir noktaya gelmesi, eğitim sisteminin bazı alanlarda ilerleme kaydettiğini gösteriyor.


Ancak burada asıl sorulması gereken soru şudur: Türkiye yükseldi mi, yoksa diğer ülkeler gerilediği için mi Türkiye'nin sıralaması yükseldi?


Bu sorunun cevabı, PISA sonuçlarının doğru yorumlanması açısından son derece önemli.


Bir başka önemli konu ise puan ile sıra arasındaki farktır. Bir ülkenin sıralamada yükselmesi her zaman öğrencilerinin daha fazla öğrendiği anlamına gelmez. Çünkü sıralamalar diğer ülkelerin performansından da etkilenir. Bu nedenle Türkiye'nin başarısını değerlendirirken yalnızca “kaçıncı olduk?” sorusuna değil, “kaç puan aldık, hangi alanlarda geliştik ve öğrencilerimizin hangi becerileri güçlendi?” sorularına da bakmak gerekir.


Türkiye'nin PISA'da yükselmesini küçümsemek doğru değil. Çünkü eğitimde herhangi bir yükseliş, öğrencilerin ve öğretmenlerin emeğinin sonucu. Bu nedenle elde edilen sonuç önemli bir başarı göstergesi.


Fakat bunu eğitim sistemimizin bütün sorunlarının çözüldüğünün kanıtı olarak görmek de doğru değil.


Türkiye'nin eğitim sisteminde hâlâ; öğrenciler arasındaki fırsat eşitsizlikleri, okul türleri arasındaki farklılıklar, bölgesel eğitim farklılıkları, öğretmen niteliği ve çalışma koşulları, ezbere dayalı öğrenme alışkanlıkları, eleştirel ve yaratıcı düşünme becerilerinin geliştirilmesi, okuma kültürünün güçlendirilmesi gibi önemli sorunlar bulunuyor.


Bu nedenle PISA 2025'i bir sonuçtan çok bir işaret olarak okumak gerekir.


Bu işaret bize şunu söylüyor: Doğru adımlar atıldığında Türkiye'nin öğrencileri daha yüksek performans gösterebilmekte.


Şimdi yapılması gereken, bu yükselişin nedenlerini doğru analiz etmek ve elde edilen kazanımları kalıcı hâle getirmektir.


Türkiye'nin yeni eğitim yaklaşımı açısından PISA sonuçlarının ayrıca değerlendirilmesi gerekir.


Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli; bilgi aktarımının yanında beceri, değer, düşünme, problem çözme ve okuryazarlık alanlarını daha fazla öne çıkarmayı hedefliyor.


PISA'nın da öğrencilerin yalnızca bilgiyi bilip bilmediğine değil, bilgiyi kullanabilme, yorumlayabilme, problem çözebilme ve gerçek yaşam durumlarına uygulayabilme becerilerine önem vermesi, iki yaklaşım arasında önemli bir kesişim noktası oluşturuyor.


Ancak burada aceleci davranmamak gerekir. ISA 2025'te değerlendirilen öğrencilerin büyük bölümü, Maarif Modeli'nin bugünkü uygulamalarının ürünü değil. Bu nedenle 2025 sonuçlarını doğrudan Maarif Modeli'nin başarısı veya başarısızlığı olarak değerlendirmek bilimsel açıdan doğru olmaz. Maarif Modeli'nin gerçek sonuçlarını görmek için önümüzdeki PISA döngülerinin yanı sıra ulusal ve uluslararası başka göstergeleri de birlikte değerlendirmek gerekir.


Eğitim sisteminin başarısını yalnızca PISA sıralamasıyla ölçmek doğru değil. Bir eğitim sisteminin gerçek başarısı; düşünebilen, sorgulayabilen, üretebilen, sorun çözebilen, bilimsel yaklaşımı benimseyen, farklılıklara saygı gösterebilen ve toplumsal sorumluluk taşıyan bireyler yetiştirebilmesiyle ölçülmeli.


PISA bize önemli bir ayna tutmaktadır. Fakat aynada gördüğümüz yalnızca üç alanın fotoğrafıdır. Eğitim sisteminin tamamını görebilmek için daha geniş bir fotoğrafa ihtiyaç var.


Bu nedenle Türkiye'nin PISA 2025 performansına benim yaklaşımım şu: Türkiye başarısız değil. Aksine, önceki döneme göre önemli bir ilerleme gösterdi. Ancak bu başarı, rehavete kapılmak …

title: Abdullah Ocalan: "Li ber Tirkiyeyê derfeteke dîrokî heye"
content:
Heyeta DEM Partiyê ya Îmraliyê ku ji parlamenter Pervîn Buldan, Mithat Sancar û parêzer Faîk Ozgur Erol pêk tê dûh li Girava Îmraliyê bi Abdullah Ocalan re hevdîtinek pêk anî.


Heyetê tekildarî hevdîtinê daxuyaniyeke niviskî bi raya giştî re parve kir.


Daxuyanî heyeta Îmraliyê wiha ye:


“Ji Çapemenî û Raya Giştî re,


Weke Lijneya Îmraliyê ya DEM Partiyê, me di 13ê Îlona 2026an de li Girava Îmraliyê bi Birêz Abdullah Ocalan re hevdîtinek pêk anî.


Di hevdîtinê de li ser rewşa heyî ya Tirkiyeyê, pêşxistina çareseriya demokratîk û aştiyeke mayînde, gavên şênber ên ku ji bo pêşvebirina pêvajoyê divê bên avêtin û pêşketinên herêmî hatin nîqaşkirin.


Kurteya nirxandinên Birêz Abdullah Ocalan ên ji bo raya giştî hatine şandin ev in:


“Pêvajoya Aştî û Civaka Demokratîk di qonaxeke wisa de ye ku pêwîstî bi awayekî bilez bi bicihanîna berpirsiyariyên dîrokî heye. Di heyama piştî pejirandina qanûnê de, pir girîng e ku di çarçoveya van berpirsiyariyan de gavên pratîkî yên hevbeş bên avêtin û lijne dest bi xebata xwe ya çalak bikin.


“Armanca min ew e ku aştî û siyasîbûn pêk werin. Aştî tê wateya çekdanînê, siyasîbûn jî tê wateya siyaseta demokratîk û civata demokratîk.


“Li ber Tirkiyeyê derfeteke dîrokî heye. Ez hêvî û bawer dikim ku her kes dê bi vê hişmendiyê tevbigerin da ku em aştiyeke mayînde û çareseriyeke demokratîk bi dest bixin. Berpirsyariyeke demildest e ku îradeya aştiyê bêbingeh neyê hiştin, bi rêya sazkirinên qanûnî û siyasî yên şênber bê misogerkirin.


“Pêvajoya Aştî û Civaka Demokratîk armanc dike ku hemû gel û baweriyên li Rojhilata Navîn bi hev re di nav aştî, azadî û wekheviyê de bijîn. Geşedanên li herêmê bi awayekî zelal nîşan didin ku pêvajo li ser hevsengiyên hesas e û ev geşedan rasterast bandorê li pêvajoyê dikin. Ji ber vê yekê, ji bo pêşîgirtina li provokasyonên muhtemel, girîng e ku pirsgirêkên li herêmê bi rêya diyalog û danûstandinan bên çareserkirin. Divê bûyerên li Rojava jî di vê çarçoveyê de bên nirxandin.”


Weke Lijneya Îmraliyê ya Partiya DEMê, em careke din diyar dikin ku rêbaza bingehîn a Birêz Ocalan mayîndekirina aştiyê, xurtkirina siyaseta demokratîk û demokratîkkirina Tirkiyeyê ye.


Rêya aştiyê vekirî ye. Niha dem dema wê ye ku îradeya siyasî û pratîk ji bo pêşvebirina vê rêyê bê pêkanîn.


Bi rêzdarî.”


(FY/AY)

author: GPT
title: Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund
content:
Anwohner:innen dokumentierten diesen Sommer in Interlaken

Kutschpferde im Dauereinsatz

: dasselbe Pferd um 14 und um 21 Uhr desselben Tages, bei 31 Grad. Das kantonale Veterinäramt erklärte zu einer Temperaturlimite, die Tierschutzgesetzgebung biete

«keine Grundlage für derartige Anordnungen»

. An dieser Lücke setzen die drei Vorstösse an.


Die

Tierschutzverordnung

 regelt, wie viel Bewegung ein Pferd mindestens braucht – nicht, wie lange es vor der Kutsche arbeiten darf. Hitzeschutz schreibt sie für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine vor, für Pferde im Geschirr fehlt jede Bestimmung. Die Motion von Nationalrätin Meret Schneider (Grüne) beauftragt den Bundesrat deshalb, die Verordnung zu ergänzen: mit einer Höchstdauer des täglichen Einsatzes und Ruhezeiten, Einsatzgrenzen bei Hitze und einem Fachkundenachweis für das gewerbliche Kutschieren.


«Die Tierschutzverordnung kennt Hitzeschutz für Wasserbüffel, Yaks und Schweine – nur für Pferde, die bei grosser Hitze Kutschen über den Asphalt ziehen, fehlt jede Regel», sagt Meret Schneider. «Diese Lücke kann der Bundesrat auf dem Verordnungsweg schliessen, ohne Gesetzesänderung.»


Wie gross die Risiken auch für Menschen sind, zeigte der

Unfall im Val Roseg

 vom 16. August: Die Bremsleistung einer Kutsche reichte nicht mehr aus, ein Pferd stürzte, das Fuhrwerk prallte gegen einen Baum. Eine 73-jährige Frau starb, zwölf Mitfahrende wurden verletzt. Wer ein Tierfuhrwerk lenkt, braucht nach Bundesrecht einzig das vollendete vierzehnte Altersjahr, eine Prüfung besteht nicht.


Im Grossen Rat verlangt Susanne Clauss (SP) mit der Interpellation «Hitzefrei für Kutschpferde?» Auskunft darüber, wie viele Pferde im Kanton Bern für gewerbliche Kutschfahrten eingesetzt werden, wie der Kanton kontrolliert und was aus den Meldungen aus der Bevölkerung wird.


«Verbindliche Regeln nehmen den sorgfältigen Betrieben nichts weg», sagt Susanne Clauss. «Sie stoppen die Betriebe, die ihr Pferd von Mittag bis Mitternacht durcharbeiten lassen.»


In der Stadt Bern fragt Tobias Sennhauser, Stadtrat von Tier im Fokus (TIF), welche Bewilligungen die Stadt für Kutschenbetriebe erteilt, welche Vorgaben für die Kutschenfahrten des städtischen Tierparks gelten und wie weit ihr Handlungsspielraum reicht – bis hin zu einem Verbot.


«Die Kutsche ist Unterhaltung auf Kosten der Tiere», sagt Tobias Sennhauser. «Wir wollen von der Stadt wissen, ob sie im 21. Jahrhundert daran festhalten will, Pferde zwischen Tram, Bussen und Menschenmengen einzuspannen.»


Andere Städte sind weiter:

Berlin

 lässt seit 2019 ab 30 Grad im Schatten keine Kutschfahrten mehr zu, Barcelona, Madrid und Málaga haben den gewerblichen Kutschenbetrieb ganz beendet.


Der Beitrag

Kutschpferde ohne Schutz: Vorstösse in Stadt, Kanton und Bund

 erschien zuerst auf

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

.

author: Dr. Yvonne Würz
title: Bärenzwinger Droyßig: 9 Tier- und Artenschutzverbände fordern Ende der Bärenhaltung
content:
Update vom 7. September 2026 

 


Am 6. September 2026 haben die Einwohner:innen von Droyßig über die Zukunft der Bärenhaltung im Bärenzwinger abgestimmt. Leider sprach sich eine Mehrheit von 59 Prozent dafür aus, die Haltung mit einem „naturnahen“ Gehege und neuen Bären fortzuführen. 


Wir von PETA Deutschland setzen uns bereits seit 2012 für das Ende der Haltung in einem der letzten „Bärenzwinger” Deutschlands ein und bedauern, dass die Mehrheit daran festhalten möchte. Aus Tierschutzsicht bleibt unsere Position unverändert: Droyßig kann seine Geschichte bewahren, ohne Bären einzusperren. Deshalb hatten wir schon im Vorfeld der Abstimmung das Gespräch mit der Gemeindeverwaltung gesucht. Dabei haben wir nochmals deutlich gemacht, dass wir auch die bislang diskutierte Erweiterung des bestehenden Geheges nicht für ausreichend halten. Denn auch eine zusätzliche Fläche im Schlosspark bliebe mitten im Siedlungsgebiet und wäre für ein echtes Bärenleben nicht ausreichend. Unabhängig vom Ausgang der Befragung muss nun der Gemeinderat entscheiden. 


Sollte die Gemeinde trotz aller Tierschutzbedenken an der Bärenhaltung festhalten, erwarten wir zumindest eine grundlegende Neuausrichtung: Statt der bisherigen Haltung im und am Schlossgraben müsste eine echte Auffangstation entstehen, die ausschließlich geretteten Bären aus schlechten Haltungsbedingungen ein Zuhause bietet. Nachzucht und die Anschaffung neuer Jungbären lehnen wir ab. Eine solche Einrichtung müsste deutlich mehr Platz, naturnahe Strukturen und ausreichende Rückzugsmöglichkeiten bieten. Ob eine derart bärengerechte Haltung im Ortsgebiet von Droyßig überhaupt realisierbar ist, muss aus unserer Sicht vorab fachlich geprüft werden. Außerdem sollte der derzeit in Droyßig lebende Bär Toni zeitnah an eine spezialisierte Auffangstation überführt werden.  


Originaltext


Seit 160 Jahren sperrt Droyßig sein „Wappentier“, den Bären, in den Schlossgraben der Gemeinde in Sachsen-Anhalt. Aktuell leben dort die Braunbären Aiko und Toni in

Gefangenschaft

. Für eine geplante Sanierung des Schlosses, für die Gerüste aufgestellt werden müssen, sind die Bären „im Weg“. Das Bärengehege soll deswegen kostenintensiv erweitert werden. Eine zeitweilige Umsiedlung der Bärenbrüder lehnt die zuständige Veterinärbehörde ab. Neun Tier- und Artenschutzverbände – darunter wir von PETA Deutschland – wandten sich in einem

Schreiben

 an die zuständigen Bürgermeister sowie den Gemeinderat und das Veterinäramt, um das Ende der Bärenhaltung zu fordern.


Neun Tier- und Artenschutzverbände fordern das Ende der Bärenhaltung


Die Braunbären Toni und Aiko leben in einem nur etwa 500 Quadratmeter kleinen Gehege, begrenzt von Schlossmauer und Glaswänden. Das entspricht einer Fläche von nur knapp zwei Tennisfeldern. Das Gehege im Graben des Schlosses ist nicht für die komplexen Bedürfnisse der Bären ausgelegt – weder genügend Platz, Beschäftigung noch Rückzugsmöglichkeiten vor den Blicken des Publikums sind vorhanden. Trotzdem hält die Gemeinde Droyßig an der Bärenhaltung fest und plant auch nach dem Tod von Toni und Aiko nicht, diese zu beenden.


Im Schreiben an den Bürgermeister der Verbandsgemeinde von Droyßiger-Zeitzer Forst, Uwe Kraneis, sowie an den Bürgermeister von Droyßig, Heiko Arnold, an den Gemeinderat und das zuständige Veterinäramt kritisieren wir das Vorhaben und appellieren an die Verantwortlichen, die unzeitgemäße Bärenhaltung aufzugeben. Stattdessen sollte Aiko und Toni ein würdevoller Lebensabend in einer geeigneten

Auffangstation

 ermöglicht werden. Denn auch eine Erweiterung des Geheges wird die Bedingungen für die Bären nicht grundlegend verbessern.


Verbändebrief gegen die Bärenhaltung im Schlossgraben Droyßig


Ein Leben in Gefangenschaft: Schwere Folgen für Toni und Aiko


In Freiheit lebende Bären sind meist Einzelgänger. Sie bewegen sich auf großen Flächen von mehreren Hundert Quadratkilometern, verstecken sich, graben und klettern. All das können Toni und Aiko in Gefangenschaft nicht. Die Stiftung für Bären warnt vor möglichen körperlichen und psychischen Schäden, die Bären und andere Tiere in Gefangenschaft oftmals erleiden. Dazu gehören

stereotype Verhaltensweisen

 wie ständiges Hin- und Herlaufen, Auf- und Abschwingen sowie Drehen des Kopfes, aber auch körperliche Krankheiten wie Arthrose und Verfettung.

author: Markus V. Hoehne
title: Why the US should not recognize Somaliland
content:
Steven A. Cook argues in a recent piece on

“Why the United States Should Recognize Somaliland”

 that the main reason for recognizing Somaliland is geostrategic. The stakes at play are “confronting the IRGC [Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps] and the Houthis as well as shoring up freedom of navigation” (through the Strait of Hormuz and, by extension, the Red Sea and the Suez Canal). He mentions in his account that besides many positive aspects, there were some problems in Somaliland. Concretely, he stresses that “there is opposition to the government among some clans, especially in the east, where sentiment runs in favor of ties with Mogadishu rather than Hargeisa — Somaliland’s capital. This raises the possibility of violent inter-clan conflict in Somaliland. It is a legitimate concern. The good news is that [Somaliland’s President] Irro says he is committed to peaceful dialogue.” This is quite naïve, or willingly ignores the more complex facts. The opposition of those clans in the east is

long-standing

. Somaliland actually never really controlled the eastern territories, except Lasanod from 2007 to 2022. Armed rebellion emerged there as early as 2009, and in 2023 the militias of the clans in the east defeated the Somaliland army. Since then, a new administration, the North East State (NES) of Somalia, has been established there. Its capital is Lasanod. The NES is recognized by the government in Mogadishu. In August 2026, the Somali prime minister

visited Lasanod

 to discuss, among other things, establishing a base of the Somali National Army (SNA) there. This means that external pushes for Somaliland’s legal independence will likely trigger not only inter-clan conflict but war. In any case, this is well beyond “peaceful dialogue,” and President Irro’s legitimacy ends, at the latest, in Oog, which is an Isaaq-inhabited town some 85 kilometers west of Lasanod. Isaaq, as a rule, support Somaliland. Members of the Dhulbahante and Warsangeli clans in the east typically are Somali unionists. 

Steven A. Cook continues in his text that “even taking into account this problem [the contestation of Somaliland in the east], Somaliland stands in contrast to Somalia itself, which has been a fount of terrorism, piracy, and extremism in the Horn of Africa for decades.” Now, ask yourself why Somalia is in such bad shape. Just recall the interventions conducted or backed by the US in Somalia, starting with “Restore Hope” in 1992, which was aborted in 1994, and continuing with the counterterrorism interventions conducted by Ethiopia in December 2006, strongly supported by the US. The first intervention actually fueled the market of violence in Somalia. Some warlords were elevated to “partners” (potential presidential candidates), others were considered villains. When US troops attempted to arrest Mohamed Farah Aideed, they were attacked in the streets of Mogadishu. “Black Hawk Down” ended in 18 Marines being killed and partly mutilated and foreclosed direct US engagement abroad for years. Thus, Washington resorted to indirect interventions, financing warlords and encouraging Ethiopia to do the dirty work in Somalia, especially when, after 9/11, Somalia was (partly wrongly, as

declassified US secret service sources show

) considered a hotbed of Islamic terrorism. Washington sanctioned the extremely brutal Ethiopian intervention from December 2006 onward, in which thousands — many of them civilians — were killed in Mogadishu and the surrounding areas. This carnage was a main reason why Somalis from across the Horn, including Somaliland, started viewing al-Shabaab as a legitimate defender of the Somali nation. Until the end of 2006, al-Shabaab had a few hundred active fighters. By mid-2007, this number had grown to several thousand, with some young men coming from Hargeysa and elsewhere in Somaliland to volunteer to defend Mogadishu against the Ethiopians (and the Ugandans and Burundians who had entered after February 2007 as part of the African Union mission, which also caused havoc for years). Counterterrorism produced massive terrorism in Somalia and made al-Shabaab big (

see here for a longer argument

).

Now, just briefly: Compare what came out of the many interventions in Somalia with what came out of non-intervention in Rwanda. When the genocide happened in Rwanda in mid-1994, the UN and the US actively ignored it, refusing to openly state what many already knew — that genocide was happening, and that one could have …

author: Fabrizio Floris
title: When protecting local traders turns foreigners into targets
content:
On Dennis Pritt Road in Nairobi’s Kilimani district,

long queues formed outside the Burundian embassy on 7 September

. People were waiting for laissez-passers, temporary travel documents enabling them to return home without valid passports. The embassy had offered to issue them free of charge. Early social-media reports also referred to Congolese nationals preparing to leave Kenya. None of those in line had necessarily received an individual deportation order. They were responding to something less formal but already powerful: the expectation that remaining in Kenya might soon become unsafe or impossible.


Five days earlier,

President William Ruto had told representatives of micro, small and medium enterprises at State House that the government would act against foreigners engaged in hawking and small retail

. Referring to legislation still before parliament, he argued that some economic activities should be reserved for Kenyans. He then moved from future legislation to immediate instruction: “Hawa wachuuzi ambao wanafanya biashara ndogo ndogo wafunge, na wasipofunga…” – these traders running small businesses must close, and if they do not… The unfinished sentence carried its own threat.


Ruto’s argument rested on a distinction between two kinds of foreign presence. Kenya had worked to attract investors who bring capital, factories and jobs, he said, not traders who compete with Kenyans at the bottom of the retail economy. He called for loopholes to be closed so that someone could not come from China to work as a hawker.

The government also urged parliament to accelerate the Local Content Bill 2025

, which seeks to raise Kenyan employment and procurement within foreign-owned firms.


By the eve of the announced crackdown, the government was trying to narrow the meaning of the president’s words.

Trade Cabinet Secretary Lee Kinyanjui said visa-free entry does not confer a right to work or trade

 and that action would target people operating outside the conditions of their immigration status. Foreign Affairs Principal Secretary Korir Sing’Oei went further, insisting that foreign nationals with the required work permits and licences remained legally protected, whether their businesses were large or small. Kenya, he said, was still open to Burundians, East Africans and Africans more broadly.


This clarification matters, but it does not remove the contradiction. Ruto’s original distinction was not simply between documented and undocumented migrants. It was between foreign investors considered economically useful and foreigners occupying low-capital activities supposedly meant for citizens. Nor did he explain which businesses were too small for foreign participation, or the legal basis for closing them before parliament had passed the proposed law.


That ambiguity is especially dangerous in an economy where informality is not an exceptional condition. Kenyan citizens as well as migrants combine casual employment, street vending and small-scale trade, often working across uncertain boundaries of licensing and registration. If informality becomes intolerable only when practised by a foreigner, immigration status ceases to be the real criterion. Nationality becomes a proxy for deciding who is entitled to make a living.


The first consequences were visible before enforcement began.

Videos circulating online showed confrontations with foreign vendors; in one, people appeared to take goods without paying

. Burundi sought assurances for the safety of its nationals and raised concerns about harassment and mistreatment. Kenyan civil-society organisations warned that indiscriminate enforcement could encourage ethnic profiling, persecution and violence. The queues outside the embassy were therefore not merely an administrative response. They were evidence that political language had already altered migrants’ assessment of risk.


Street vendors in Nairobi 2025


This is where Kenya’s debate begins to resemble South Africa’s.

South African xenophobia is often described as irrational hatred, but its public justification is frequently economic

. Foreigners are accused of taking jobs, undercutting prices, occupying trading spaces or accepting conditions local workers cannot survive on. Migrant-run spaza shops and informal businesses have consequently become recurring targets of intimidation, looting and destruction.


The decisive shift occurs when enforcing immigration rules no longer belongs exclusively to public …

author: Moataz Hagag
title: How agricultural reclamation village Al-Ray bel-Rash became beset by weapons, drugs and the informal gold trade
content:
Two armored vehicles, a police car and two small open pick-up trucks entered the Al-Ray bel-Rash village in the Edfu district in northern Aswan in the afternoon of September 5, part of a security campaign targeting the home of Abdallah al-Hugairy. 


An exchange of fire that would last around two and a half hours was about to begin.


Hugairy has repeatedly been implicated in incidents of gunfire and forcefully stealing cars, motorcycles and tuk tuks from villagers and

dahaba

(people who work in informal gold mining), according to  Ahmed al-Bagga, a farmer from the village.

 He also says Hugairy is among those accused of killing a villager about two years ago.


Bagga tells Mada Masr that Hugairy fought most of Saturday’s skirmish alone, before jumping from the roof of his house to that of a neighbor, whose livestock, “his source of livelihood,” was hit and killed by a stray bullet in the fray. Bagga says two police personnel were wounded in the uproar: the assistant investigator at the Edfu district, Mohamed Zidan, and a police conscript. News circulating about the incident recorded Zidan’s injury, without mentioning the conscript or further detailing the raid.


Despite all this, Hugairy managed to escape from the village, while security forces raided another house, killed its owner — whom Bagga describes as a drug dealer — and then withdrew from the area. 


The next day, Hugairy returned to the village, “as if nothing had happened,” Bagga says.


The eruption of violence at the beginning of the month exposes the recurring pattern that has taken root in Al-Ray bel-Rash. The village sank into deprivation in the 1990s, isolated from essential resources and services. Residents describe how these conditions gave space and air to the flourishing of informal and illicit arms and drug trades. 


Occasional security interventions and clashes, increasing over recent years, have done little to break these trades’ entrenchment. 


Instead, the volatile dynamic has deepened the isolation of both the village and its residents.


The village, whose name roughly translates to sprinkle irrigation, was established only around six decades ago as part of a state-sponsored agricultural reclamation project. One of its farmers, Shazly, describes it to Mada Masr as still “the most famous village growing tomatoes in the governorate” of Aswan.


So how has the village become a place whose name, for those in the area, is synonymous with drugs and weapons?


The beginning of the road linking the desert to the village of Al-Ray bel-Rash in northern Aswan, September 2025. Photo: Mada Masr


*

*

*


Al-Ray bel-Rash was established in 1968 as part of an agricultural reclamation project implemented by the

Upper Egypt Agricultural Company

 in Wadi al-Radisiyah.

 


When the company was

liquidated

 in 1990, the lands it had reclaimed from the desert were broken up and re-apportioned to individual farmers — the company’s former employees — at reduced prices per feddan payable with a low interest rate over a 30-year period, on condition that the employees accept their redundancy from the company and be barred from applying to government jobs in the future.


It’s here that the problems begin.

According to an agricultural administration employee speaking to Mada Masr on condition of anonymity, when the

Upper Egypt company

was active, it cultivated only around 300 of the roughly 1,500 feddans that fall within the village’s official boundaries.


But when the employees became land owners, they needed to make a living from farming and accumulate money to pay off the land’s cost and the interest. So, they sought to cultivate their new plots to the fullest possible extent.


The village was not equipped to host all of this activity. Wadi Radisiyah begins at the villages of Tunab and Hasaya near the Nile, deepening eastward into the desert and passing through the villages of Bassaly, Zaqlouna, Raiya, reaching Al-Ray bel-Rash and Umm Salama before approaching the Nile again at the neighboring Adwa village.


Al-Ray bel-Rash is more or less in the middle of this stretch, furthest from a water source at either end and surrounded by desert. To reach the village, Nile waters must first make a long journey via lifting stations and canals.


The water that was sufficient for the company to cultivate roughly one-fifth of the village’s total area was no longer enough for the new owners to cultivate the entire tract.


“The company handed over the …

author: Deogracious Kalima
title: Young Zimbabweans are being “kidnapped” and sent to rehab camps. Former detainees say they were tortured inside
content:
Former detainees say they were tortured inside.

Harare, Zimbabwe (Minority Africa) â

In the heart of Mbare Township, Harareâs poorest and most populated slum, there is a new and menacing economy emerging.

âItâs the drug trade and itâs on steroids,â says John Gwada, a community leader and pastor with the Zimbabwe Apostolic Church. Zimbabweâs youth substance abuse crisis has skyrocketed from 43% in 2017 to 57% in 2019, and is believed to be much worse today, according to the Zimbabwe Civil Liberties and Drugs Network, a monitoring agency.

This new dark-street economy is built on the broken lives of Zimbabweâs so-called âLost Generationââyoung adults born after 2000 who are the demographic most affected by the countryâs dire unemployment crisis. In 2023, researchers, citing social workers and addiction specialists, reported that 43% of school-going youths were hooked on illicit substances ranging from crystal meth (locally known as mutoriro) to tainted cough syrups and imported cocaine.

âItâs a mess, kids abandoning school, some chasing their parents out of their homes, others selling all the household furniture just to buy the next supply and feed their cravings for mutoriro,â Gwada says.

But the real horror isn't just found in the âstreet bases,â where the drugs are sold in small sachets and makeshift beer bottles. It lies behind the immaculate, steel-wire fences of so-called ârehab boot campsâ that claim to reform youths battling addictions, all for free.

Our investigation into Zimbabweâs mushrooming âdrug rehabilitationâ hubs shows that they have become a cesspool of corruption and brutality, where politically connected elites have turned a public health crisis into a money-spinning racket.

At centres such as Matrix Rehabilitation Centre, which began working around 2021/2022, and the Angel of Hope Foundation, established in Harare in 2018, former detainees and their families allege that the road to sobriety involves cash bribes, military-style torture, unlawful detention, and the disregard of basic human rights.

To a desperate parent such as Chipo Ganga*, watching her 17-year-old son waste away through mutoriro addiction, it didnât take much to fall for the sleek adverts on TikTok and Facebook promoting Zimbabweâs âdrug rehab colleges.â

âI was desperate to save my teenage son in 2025, the rehab adverts looked godsend,â she says.

The advertisements promise âholistic therapy,â âpsychological assessments,â and a path back to sanity, education, or employment for âsaved youths.â In Zimbabwe, where the formal healthcare system has all but collapsed and only 18 psychiatrists reportedly serve a population of 17 million, these seemingly non-profit rehabilitation centres pose as the only remaining hope for parents whose children are addicted to crystal meth, cocaine, illicit alcohol, or other narcotics.

The Matrix Rehabilitation Centre, owned by Tafadzwa Chidawa, a politically connected former police officer who was acquitted in March last year of an unrelated US $20,000 fraud case, and Angel of Hope, a foundation headed by Zimbabweâs First Lady, Auxillia Mnangagwa, are the most prominent of these so-called ârehab colleges.â

They claim to offer free or subsidised programmes lasting between one and three months to transform young people battling addiction into productive members of society.

But Matrixâs pitch extends beyond rehabilitation. In videos and advertisements reviewed by Minority Africa, the centre presents its programmes as a pathway to opportunities after participants leave, including education and travel abroad. Posts promote opportunities in countries including India and the United Arab Emirates, while others document participants obtaining visas and travelling overseas to study.

In one video posted in August 2026, Matrix celebrated a young woman receiving a visa to study abroad, before later chronicling her journey to India. The posts present such departures as evidence of what can follow the centreâs disciplinary programme.

Matrix has made varying claims about the success of its rehabilitation programme. In separate posts on social media, the centre has claimed success rates of 92% and 97%. The posts do not explain how Matrix defines âsuccess,â the period over which participants are followed, or what data the figures are based on.
