title: Die europäische Mauer in der spanischen Exklave Ceuta: Wieder einmal erfolgreich gestürmt
content:
Dossier


Etwa 500 Flüchtlingen aus dem subsaharischen Afrika gelang es in der letzten Woche, die europäische Mauer in der spanischen Exklave (sprich: Kolonialbesitzung in Afrika) Ceuta zu überwinden. Der kurze

Videofilm „Cientos de subsaharianos entran en Ceuta“, am 16. Februar 2017 von Faro TV auf You Tube

 


 gepostet, zeigt ihre Ankuft, und – nicht zuletzt – die Freude über die gelungene Überwindung und über das Wiedersehen mit Freunden oder Familienangehörigen. Das ist der Unterschied zwischen EU und Trump. Der will an der Grenze eine Mauer bauen, die EU baut Festungsmauern gleich „im Feindesland“… Siehe Hintergründe und weitere „Stürmungen“:


Für Spaniens Regierung wird der Umgang mit den Minderjährigen in Ceuta zum Lackmustest als letzte Bastion einer humanen Migrationspolitik“


„… Während in Spanien dabei zunächst ein möglicherweise beabsichtigtes Versagen der marokkanischen Grenzkontrollen im Fokus stand, konzentrierte man sich im Rest Europas auf Madrids Rolle in der gemeinsamen Migrationspolitik. Aus der Grenzkrise wurde in wenigen Tagen ein europäischer Richtungsstreit.


Den Aufschlag machte dabei Italiens rechte Premierministerin Giorgia Meloni. Bereits am 31. Juli führte Rom Kontrollen für Drittstaatsangehörige ein, die aus Spanien einreisten, und begründete diesen Schritt mit Risiken für Italiens nationale Sicherheit. Spaniens Premier Pedro Sánchez reagierte mit einem scharfen Brief an EU-Kommissionspräsidentin Ursula von der Leyen, in dem er neben der »solidaritätsbasierten Einwanderungspolitik« auch den effektiven Grenzschutz seines Landes betonte und eine Dringlichkeitssitzung der EU-Innenminister forderte. Fast zeitgleich kritisierten 22 EU-Staaten, angeführt von Italien und Dänemark, die spanische Migrationspolitik als möglichen »Pullfaktor«. In ihrem Schreiben bezog sich die Gruppe vor allem auf eine Regelung, die international als Dreh- und Angelpunkt des spanischen Sonderwegs in Sachen Migration wahrgenommen worden war. Im Frühjahr hatte die Linkskoalition eine außerordentliche Legalisierung für Menschen beschlossen, die bereits seit längerem ohne regulären Aufenthaltsstatus in Spanien lebten. Etwa 600 000 Anträge waren bis Fristende zugelassen worden.


Mit einer Retourkutsche Anfang August setzte sich die Konfrontation auch auf symbolischer Ebene fort: Nun fragten spanische Grenzbeamte an Häfen und Flughäfen aus Italien Anreisende nach den Papieren. Deutlicher als mit wechselseitigen Kontrollen ließ sich die Konfrontation zwischen der Postfaschistin Meloni und dem Sozialdemokraten Sánchez kaum inszenieren. Doch das Szenario änderte sich schneller, als es die starken Bilder vermuten ließen.


Als zwei Wochen später in den Sozialen Medien erneut zu einem massiven Grenzübertritt mobilisiert wurde, war kein Durchkommen mehr. Nicht nur Marokko hatte am 15. August tausende Sicherheitsbeamte in die Region geschickt, um das Umland abzusichern, auch Spanien hatte deutlich aufgerüstet: Am Grenzübergang El Tarajal standen gepanzerte Armeefahrzeuge bereit, entlang der Küste patrouillierten Boote von Militär und der Guardia Civil, Spaniens militärisch organisierter nationale Polizei. So martialisch hatte sich das Land unter Sánchez’ Linksregierung selten inszeniert. Bereits in den Tagen zuvor hatte sie den Ton deutlich verschärft. Jeder Migrant, der in Ceuta die Grenze irregulär übertreten habe, werde ausgewiesen, verkündete Außenminister José Manuel Albares. (…)


Damit setzte die Regierung auch ein innenpolitisches Signal. Denn an kaum einem Thema entzündet sich die politische Polarisierung im Land so schnell wie am Umgang mit irregulärer Migration, vor allem mit den minderjährigen Migrantinnen und Migranten. Unbegleitete Kinder und Jugendliche dürfen laut UN-Kinderrechtskonvention und spanischem Ausländerrecht nur dann zu ihren Familien und in ihr Herkunftsland zurückgeführt werden, wenn sie dort angemessen betreut werden können. Dazu ist eine Einzelfallprüfung notwendig. In Ceuta hat die Polizei bis zum 18. August laut Behörden 2168 unbegleitete Kinder und Jugendliche registriert. (…)


Die Radikalisierung des Diskurses zeigt Parallelen zum Abschottungstrend in weiten Teilen Europas und der USA, hat aber auch einen spezifisch spanischen Hintergrund. Das Phänomen allein reisender Kinder und Jugendlicher kennen spanische Behörden bereits seit den frühen 2000er Jahren, sie entwickelten aber lange keine strategische Antwort. So entstand ein chronisches Problem. (…)

title: İsveç'te halk genel seçimler için sandık başında
content:
Sandık başına giden seçmenler, İsveç Parlamentosunda 349 sandalye, 21 bölgesel meclis ve 290 belediye meclis üyesini belirleyecek. Seçmenler, saat 21.00’e kadar sandık başına giderek oylarını kullanabilecek.


Demirtaş’tan İsveç seçimleri öncesi Sosyal Demokratlara mesaj


31 Ağustos 2026


Anketlere göre hangi ittifak önde?


İsveç'te seçim öncesi yapılan son anketlere göre muhalefetteki Sosyal Demokratlar, Merkez Parti (Centerpartiet), Yeşiller Partisi ve Sol Parti'nin (Vansterpartiet) oluşturduğu merkez sol blokun yüzde 50,8 oyla ilk sırada yer alıyor.


İsveç seçimlerine doğru Kadir Kasirga: Refah devleti mi, büyüyen eşitsizlik mi?


1 Eylül 2026


İktidardaki sağ blok partileri Ilımlı Muhafazakar Parti, Hristiyan Demokratlar, Liberaller ve mevcut hükümete dışarıdan destek veren İsveç Demokratlarının oy oranının ise yüzde 47,6 olduğu ifade ediliyor.


İsveç’te seçim öncesi on binler iklim için sokakta


24 Ağustos 2026


Anket sonuçlarına göre seçimin sol ile sağ bloklar arasında "başa baş" mücadeleyle geçeceği belirtiliyor.


İsveç’te seçimlere yaklaşık iki ay kala ‘Quisling’ tartışması ve tarihin gölgesi


7 Ağustos 2026


Analizlerde ayrıca, mevcut hükümette resmi olarak yer almayan İsveç Demokratlarının yarınki seçim sonrası ilk kez hükümete doğrudan katılmasının mümkün olacağı değerlendiriliyor.


TBMM, İsveç'in NATO üyeliğini AKP-MHP-CHP oylarıyla onayladı


24 Ocak 2024


İsveç seçimleri hakkında


İsveç, bugün (13 Eylül 2026) parlamento, bölge ve belediye seçimleri için sandık başında.


Parlamento seçiminde 8 milyon 46 bin 725 kişinin oy kullanma hakkı bulunuyor. Seçmenler, 349 sandalyeli İsveç Parlamentosu Riksdag’ın yeni üyelerini belirleyecek.


Parlamentoda halen sekiz parti temsil ediliyor. Seçimin öne çıkan iki siyasi aktörü, Sosyal Demokrat Parti lideri ve eski Başbakan Magdalena Andersson ile mevcut Başbakan ve Ilımlı Birlik Partisi lideri Ulf Kristersson.


Kristersson’un hükümeti Ilımlı Birlik Partisi, Hristiyan Demokratlar ve Liberallerden oluşuyor; hükümet parlamentoda Jimmie Åkesson liderliğindeki İsveç Demokratlarının desteğine dayanıyor.


İsveç’te başbakan doğrudan halk tarafından seçilmiyor. Seçimlerin ardından oluşan yeni parlamentoda Meclis Başkanı’nın önerdiği başbakan adayı oylanıyor. Bir partinin parlamentoya girebilmesi için ülke genelinde en az yüzde 4 oy alması gerekiyor.


İsveç'te en son 2022'de yapılan seçimde katılım oranı yüzde 84 olmuştu.

title: Οι τακτικές της κακοποίησης και η απάντηση των θυμάτων
content:
Οι τακτικές της κακοποίησης και η απάντηση των θυμάτων


Με αφορμή το κείμενο καταγγελίας

(link)

 αποφάσισα να γράψω αυτή την ανάλυση, με σκοπό να βοηθήσω κι άλλες γυναίκες που βίωσαν ή βιώνουν μια παρόμοια κατάσταση. Ένα από τα πιο δύσκολα στάδια της κακοποίησης, είναι ότι δεν μπορούμε να βάλουμε σε λέξεις αυτό που μας συμβαίνει. Η ερώτηση «γιατί δεν έφυγε;» ή «γιατί ξαναγύρισε;» είναι η πιο συχνή και, δυστυχώς ,η πιο άδικη ερώτηση που αντιμετωπίζουν τα θύματα κακοποίησης. Φυσικά και το κείμενο αυτό μπορεί να χρησιμοποιηθεί ως οδηγός απαντήσεων προς όλους αυτούς που αμφισβητούν τα θύματα αλλά δεν γράφτηκε μόνο γι’ αυτό. Έχει μεγάλη σημασία να αναγνωρίσουν κι άλλες γυναίκες αυτές τις συμπεριφορές, να τις ονοματίσουν και να μη φοβηθούν να τις καταγγείλουν. Η συγκεκριμένη καταγγελία περιγράφει με τρομακτική ακρίβεια τους κλασικούς μηχανισμούς που χρησιμοποιεί ένας

συστηματικός θύτης (

serial


predator

)

 για να παγιδεύει, να χειραγωγήσει και να κρατήσει το θύμα του δεμένο στον κύκλο της κακοποίησης.


Γιατί ένα θύμα κακοποίησης επιστρέφει στο κακοποιητή του;


Τι είναι ο τραυματικός δεσμός; Γιατί είναι δύσκολο να σπάσει και γιατί η παραμονή ή η επιστροφή του θύματος δεν είναι προϊόν ελεύθερης επιλογής, αλλά το αποτέλεσμα ενός συστηματικού ψυχολογικού ακρωτηριασμού;


–

Στρατηγική επιλογή και στόχευση.

The


Targeting


Ο θύτης δεν έδρασε τυχαία. Οι δράστες αυτού του τύπου έχουν την ικανότητα να οσμίζονται την ευαλωτότητα.


Εκμετάλλευση της ανάγκης.


Γνώριζε ότι η γυναίκα βρισκόταν σε μια ευάλωτη φάση (ανάγκη για αλλαγή καριέρας, μονογονεϊκότητα, πρόσφατη κατάθλιψη).


Το προσωπείο του «Σωτήρα».


Εμφανίστηκε ως πρόθυμος, ανιδιοτελής και υποστηρικτικός. Αυτό είναι ένα κλασικό προπέτασμα καπνού για να καμφθούν οι άμυνες και να δημιουργηθεί ένα αίσθημα υποχρέωσης και εμπιστοσύνης.


– Σταδιακή παραβίαση ορίων.

Boundary


Testing

.


Οι δράστες σπάνια επιτίθενται αμέσως· πρώτα «δοκιμάζουν» τα όρια του θύματος για να δουν μέχρι πού μπορούν να φτάσουν.


Η δημιουργία συνθήκης εξάρτησης (Το ατύχημα).


Ζητώντας βοήθεια για τις σκάλες, αντέστρεψε τους ρόλους. Έβαλε τη γυναίκα σε θέση φροντιστή, μειώνοντας την υποψία της και την έφερε σε άμεση σωματική εγγύτητα.


Τα υπονοούμενα στον καφέ

:

 Ήταν η πρώτη λεκτική δοκιμή των ορίων της. Όταν είδε ότι δεν υπήρξε έντονη αντίδραση, θεώρησε ότι έχει το ‘πράσινο φως’.


–

Χειραγώγηση και κατασκευή ενοχής.

Gaslighting

/

Blame

–

shifting

.


Το γεγονός ότι η γυναίκα σκέφτηκε μήπως «ήμουν εγώ πιο φιλική» δείχνει πόσο καλά λειτουργεί η ψυχολογική χειραγώγηση αυτών των ατόμων. Ο δράστης χρησιμοποιεί το κύρος του και την αναγνωρισιμότητά του ως ασπίδα, κάνοντας το θύμα να αμφιβάλλει για το δικό του ένστικτο. Όπως η ίδια λέει, «χτύπησε αλέρτ αλλά το αγνόησα».


Στη συνέχεια ακολουθεί ο βιασμός της γυναίκας απο τον θύτη και βλέπουμε χαρακτηριστικά όπως:


-Μηδενική ενσυναίσθηση.

 Η άρνησή του να χρησιμοποιήσει προφυλακτικό δείχνει απόλυτη αδιαφορία για τη δική της υγεία, επιθυμία ή συναίνεση.


-Η ανάγκη για εξουσία:

 Ο βιασμός και η κακοποίηση δεν αφορούν το σεξ, αλλά την 

εξουσία και τον έλεγχο

. Η βίαιη στάση και η αδιαφορία για τον πόνο του θύματος δείχνουν ότι άντλησε ικανοποίηση από την επιβολή του αλλά και τον πόνο που προκάλεσε.


Πως ο Θύτης κανονικοποιεί τον βιασμό;


Η Τακτική του “

Love


Bombing

“.


Αμέσως μετά την επίθεση, ο θύτης άλλαξε στρατηγική. Αντί για σωματική βία, χρησιμοποίησε 

υπερβολική λεκτική επιβεβαίωση

 («είσαι θεά», «δεν μπορώ να σε βγάλω από το μυαλό μου»).

Στόχος του ήταν ν

α θολώσει τα νερά. Μετατρέποντας τον βιασμό σε «παθιασμένο έρωτα», ανάγκασε το θύμα να επαναπροσδιορίσει αυτό που έζησε, οδηγώντας το στη στρεβλή «συναίνεση εκ των υστέρων».


Νευροβιολογικός εθισμός-

Intermittent


Reinforcement

.


Η παγίδα της ντοπαμίνης:

 Όταν η ανταμοιβή -η στοργή- είναι απρόβλεπτη, ο εγκέφαλος εκκρίνει τεράστιες ποσότητες ντοπαμίνης. Το θύμα μπαίνει σε κατάσταση βιολογικού εθισμού, παρόμοιου με αυτό των τυχερών παιχνιδιών ή και των ναρκωτικών. Η γυναίκα δεν επιστρέφει για να φάει ξύλο· επιστρέφει επειδή ο εγκέφαλός της αναζητά απεγνωσμένα την επόμενη φάση «στοργής» για να ανακουφιστεί από το οξύ στρες που της προκάλεσε ο ίδιος ο θύτης.


Ο τραυματικός δεσμός –

Traumatic


Bonding

.


Σε συνθήκες παρατεταμένου φόβου, αναπτύσσεται ένας ασυνείδητος μηχανισμός επιβίωσης. Το θύμα προσκολλάται στον θύτη για να προστατευτεί.


Η ψευδαίσθηση της ασφάλειας.

author: Mag
title: Abelardo de la Espriella hat in Kolumbien auch die Pressefreiheit im Visier
content:
„Kolumbiens neuer Präsident Abelardo Gabriel de la Espriella Otero ist der größte Gegner der Presse des südamerikanischen Landes. Laut der Stiftung für die Pressefreiheit (FLIP) in der kolumbianischen Hauptstadt Bogotá ist er „die am aggressivsten gegen die Presse auftretende Person des öffentlichen Lebens“. Kein gutes Vorzeichen für die kommenden vier Jahre. (…) Bejarano Ricaurte ist Medienrechtlerin und verteidigt immer wieder Journalist*innen gegen Anzeigen, Klagen auf Entschädigung und Wiedergutmachung. Etliche von diesen Fällen sind mit dem Namen Abelardo de la Espriella verbunden. Recherchen der Redaktion von La Silla Vacia, einem kritischen Onlineportal bestätigen das. Demnach hat der 47-jährige neue Präsident bereits 28 Zivilklagen und 22 Strafanzeigen gegen Journalist*innen und Aktivist*innen eingereicht. Noch eindrucksvoller sind die Zahlen, die die Generalstaatsanwaltschaft auf Anfrage vorgelegt hat: demnach habe Abelardo de la Espriella zwischen 2008 und 2019 genau 109 Verfahren wegen Verleumdung und Beleidigung angstrengt…“

Artikel von Knut Henkel vom 11. August 2026 in Menschen machen Medien von ver.di


 und mehr daraus/dazu:


Pressefreiheit im Fokus der Regierung von Kolumbien: Bei Interviews und Pressekonferenzen und auch bei den öffentlich-rechtlichen Medien


„Vladimir Flórez, bekannt unter dem Künstlernamen Vladdo, hat RCN Televisión verlassen. Er ist seit fast 40 Jahren als Karikaturist tätig und war dort seit einem Jahr unter Vertrag. Die Entscheidung fiel wenige Tage nach einer kritischen Karikatur von Präsident Abelardo de la Espriella (…). Die Zeichnung zeigte wie der Präsident nach einer Militäroperation in Guaviare zwischen Leichensäcken entlanggeht. RCN begründete die Trennung mit „administrativen Gründen“. Vladdo teilte auf X mehrere Beiträge, die seinen Abgang mit der Karikatur in Verbindung brachten. Darunter war auch ein Beitrag des Karikaturisten X-tian, der vor dem Verschwinden kritischer Stimmen gegenüber der Regierung aus den traditionellen Medien warnte.


Eine Woche zuvor, am 31. August, stellte Blu Radio die Sendung „Mañanas Blu 10:30“ ein, die Camila Zuluaga und Ana Cristina Restrepo acht Jahre lang moderiert hatten und die zweimal mit dem Premio Simón Bolívar ausgezeichnet worden war. Das Team wurde erst wenige Minuten nach der letzten Ausgabe über die Entscheidung informiert. Blu Radio, Teil der Caracol-Gruppe, begründete die Einstellung mit Problemen bei den Werbeeinnahmen und niedrigen Einschaltquoten. Restrepo erklärte dagegen, ihnen seien nie entsprechende Zahlen vorgelegt worden. Die ECAR-Studien hätten die Sendung hinter der Sendung von Néstor Morales als zweitstärkstes Programm des Senders ausgewiesen. Ihrer Einschätzung nach war die Sendung für De la Espriella unbequem.


Zwei von La Silla Vacía befragte Quellen berichteten zudem von Anzeichen für Unzufriedenheit innerhalb der Regierung. Während des Wahlkampfs hatte Zuluaga erklärt, De la Espriella habe sein Team angewiesen, ihr keine Interviews zu geben. Am 3. September wurden neue Leitlinien für das Verhältnis der Regierung zu den Medien vorgestellt, die als Präsidialdirektive eins von 2026 bezeichnet werden. Die Stiftung für Pressefreiheit (FLIP) warnte, die Richtlinie schränke offenbar Interviews und Pressekonferenzen mit Medien ein, die nicht als regierungsnah gelten. Einige Minister könnten demnach nur noch Erklärungen abgeben, ohne dass Journalisten Fragen stellen dürfen. Nach Einschätzung der Organisation könnte dies kritische Nachfragen erschweren, Medien begünstigen, die die Regierung nicht infrage stellen, und Stigmatisierung sowie Selbstzensur fördern.


Die FLIP verwies in diesem Zusammenhang auf das Urteil SU-18 von 2026 des kolumbianischen Verfassungsgerichts, das die Verpflichtung des Staates bekräftigt, den Zugang zu Informationen und die Pressefreiheit zu gewährleisten. (…)


Auch bei den öffentlich-rechtlichen Medien kam es zu Veränderungen. Am 18. August ordnete Inravisión, der neue Name des zuvor unter RTVC bekannten öffentlichen Mediensystems, die Aussetzung der gesprochenen Programme der 20 „Emisoras de Paz“ an. (…) Am 10. September kündigte außerdem die Intendantin von Inravisión, Ángela María Mora Soto, die vorzeitige Beendigung von Dienstleistungsverträgen an, darunter Verträge von Journalisten, Moderatoren und Beschäftigten im Bereich digitaler Inhalte. (…)


Die ehemalige stellvertretende Intendantin María Paula Fonseca bezeichnete den Vorgang als „Arbeitsmassaker“. Vor diesem …

title: Ruben Neves'i Jota'nın adıyla hedef alan Suudi taraftarlara tepki
content:
Cristiano Ronaldo, Suudi Pro Lig'de Al Hilal'de forma giyen Ruben Neves’in hayatını kaybeden yakın arkadaşı Diogo Jota’nın adıyla yapılan tezahüratlarla hedef alınmasının ardından, olaya karışan Al Taawoun taraftarlarına ömür boyu stadyuma giriş yasağı uygulanmasını istedi.

Cumartesi günü Al Taawoun deplasmanında oynanan ve Al Hilal'in 6-0 kazandığı maçın maçın sosyal medyada yayılan görüntülerinde, Neves serbest vuruş kullanmaya hazırlanırken tribünlerden söz konusu tezahüratlar duyuluyor. Neves tezahüratlar üzerine elini yukarı kaldırarak "Allah görüyor" işareti yapıyor.

Ruben Neves, maç sonu yaptığı açıklamada "Umarım yaptıklarından sonra gidip namaz kılmazlar" dedi.

Cristiano Ronaldo ise Instagram paylaşımında Suudi Pro Ligi’ni harekete geçmeye ve bu davranışı cezalandırmaya çağırdı.

Neves’in Portekiz Milli Takımı, Porto ve Wolverhampton’dan yakın arkadaşı Liverpool oyuncusu Jota, Temmuz 2025’te İspanya’da kardeşi Andre Silva ile geçirdiği trafik kazasında 28 yaşında hayatını kaybetmişti.

title: Kredi kartında asgari ödeme yapanlar dikkat: “Mutlaka sarmalın içine düşersiniz”
content:
Topkapı Üniversitesi Rektörü, Ekonomist Prof. Dr. Emre Alkin, kredi kartı kullanımı ve borç yönetimine ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. Alkin, kredi kartı borcunun sürekli asgari ödeme yapılarak ötelenmesinin tüketiciyi borç sarmalına sürükleyebileceği uyarısında bulundu.

Kredi kartlarının gelirle uyumlu kullanılmaması ve borçların sürekli asgari ödeme yoluyla ertelenmesi, tüketicilerin finansal yükünü artırabiliyor. Borçların kapatılması için yeniden kredi çekilmesi veya farklı yollarla borçlanılması da bu sürecin daha da ağırlaşmasına neden olabiliyor.

Prof. Dr. Emre Alkin, Tgrthaber.com’a yaptığı değerlendirmede kredi kartı kullananların harcamalarını kesin gelirleriyle uyumlu tutması gerektiğini belirterek kredi kartının kişinin kendi parası gibi görülmemesi gerektiğini söyledi.

title: AKP Burdur Milletvekili Adem Korkmaz: 'Vali Tülay Baydar Bilgihan beni tehdit etti'
content:
AKP Burdur Milletvekili Prof. Dr. Adem Korkmaz, vatandaşların şikâyetlerini Ankara’da dile getirmesi nedeniyle Burdur Valisi Tülay Baydar Bilgihan’ın kendisini tehdit ettiğini öne sürerek Ankara Valiliği’nden yakın koruma talep etti.

AKP Burdur Milletvekili Prof. Dr. Adem Korkmaz, Burdur merkezli Gür Haber sitesinin YouTube ve Facebook’ta yayınlanan programına katıldı.

Korkmaz, Burdur’da zorunlu dijital su sayacına ilişkin tepkileri Ankara’da dile getirdiğini ve bunun üzerine İçişleri Bakanlığı’nın konuya müdahale ettiğini anlattı. Ardından Burdur’da kendisi hakkında, Vali Tülay Baydar Bilgihan’ın “Ben de hocayı götürürüm” şeklinde bir ifade kullandığını duyduğunu belirten Korkmaz, bu ve başka bazı konuları görüşmek üzere Vali Bilgihan ile bir araya geldiğini söyledi.

“Ben de hocayı götürürüm” ifadesini Bilgihan’a sorduğunu aktaran Korkmaz, şöyle konuştu:

“Evet, böyle bir şey olursa hocayı götürürüm. ‘Seni’ demiyor, aynı ifadeyi, ‘Hocayı götürürüm’ şeklinde tekrarlayınca konuşacak şey bitmiştir. Ben bir yıldır bunun ağırlığıyla yaşıyorum. ‘Götürürüm’ ifadesi ortada duruyor. Ne anlayacağım? Bu siyasi bir ifade midir? Benim can güvenliğimi kim koruyacak? Ben bu tehdidin içini nasıl dolduracağım? Ben bunun için Ankara Valiliği’nden koruma talep ettim, can güvenliğim için.”

Korkmaz, söz konusu dilin “ezbere bir dil olmadığını, bilinçli şekilde inşa edildiğini” söyledi. “Söylenen sözle bütünleşen uygulama ve davranışlar, en son 30 Ağustos kutlamalarında Valilikten tardedilmesi (savılması) üzerine” adresinin bulunduğu Ankara’da, valilikten koruma talep ettiğini anlattı.

Korkmaz’ın 9 Eylül 2026 tarihli Ankara Valiliği’ne sunduğu dilekçede de kendisine yönelik ifadelerin tehdit niteliğinde olduğunu belirttiği görüldü. Dilekçede, Burdur Valisi Tülay Baydar Bilgihan’ın Korkmaz’a, “Sen bana savaş açtın, ben de yine söylüyorum, bana bir şey olursa hocayı götürürüm” şeklinde ifade kullandığı öne sürüldü.

Korkmaz, söz konusu sözlerin kendisine yönelik “açık, doğrudan ve ciddi bir tehdit” niteliğinde olduğunu savundu.

Korkmaz, dilekçesinde yaşanan gelişmelerin can güvenliği açısından risk oluşturduğunu belirterek yakın koruma görevlisi tahsis edilmesini istedi. Başvuruda ayrıca yakın koruma tedbirinin milletvekilliği görevinin gerektirdiği siyasi ve kamusal faaliyetler ile il içi ve il dışı seyahatlerde de uygulanması talep edildi.

title: "1001 signatures for a Democratic Republic and Peace" declaration announced
content:
Prepared under the leadership of women, intellectuals, artists, academics, workers, and young people with the aim of contributing to efforts for peace, equal citizenship, and a democratic solution in Turkey, the "1001 Signatures for a Democratic Republic and Peace" declaration was presented at the Eyüp Sultan Culture and Arts Center. Numerous academics, politicians, journalists, and representatives of civil society organizations also spoke at the event.


Setting out with the message, "Real fairy tales begin when societies do not give up dreaming of their own future," the signatories stated that in Eastern and Western tales, the number "1001" symbolizes inexhaustible hope and the patient transformation of darkness into light; they called for the defense of social peace against a climate of conflict and division. Journalist Nezahat Doğan read the declaration.


The declaration included the following points:


"- Within the context of the ongoing peace and resolution process in Turkey, we initially support disarmament and the complete removal of all forms of violence from the country's and society's agenda.


- Acknowledging that the fundamental source of the problem is the denial of the existence of Kurds, we support securing the demand for equal citizenship constitutionally, recognizing the right to education in one's mother tongue, and efforts to remedy historical injustices.


- We support efforts to establish the Republic of Turkey firmly on the foundations of a free, democratic state governed by the rule of law, as well as demands for the full implementation of the judgments of the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR).


- We support ensuring that the actors involved in resolving this conflict, which has existed throughout the history of the Republic, are able to negotiate under free and equal conditions; and implementing the principle of benefiting from the right to hope, in accordance with ECHR judgments and the demands of the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers."


Speaking after the joint statement was read, Ahmet Türk said that an important political will had emerged regarding the resolution of the Kurdish issue in the second century of the Republic and that the process should reach a successful conclusion. Stating that Kurds had struggled against policies of denial and rejection from before the founding of the Republic to the present day, Ahmet Türk said, "A new will has emerged in the second century of the Republic. We hope and believe that this process will conclude successfully. This region has experienced not only democratic changes and transformations but also periods of conflict and hardship. It has now become imperative to resolve major issues such as the Kurdish question in this region."


Ahmet Türk said that, as the public, academics, and intellectuals, they were committed to supporting the political will that has emerged, adding: "I believe that those governing this country today will also respond to the voice raised by the 1,001 signatories here. Both Kurds and Turks have suffered during the 100 years of the Republic. We must now regard and assess the ending of this suffering and the fulfillment of the Kurdish people's demands for democracy, rights, and freedoms as an unavoidable process. Everyone who supports peace must support this process. If we do not want people to suffer, if we want different peoples to come together around shared democratic values, this is a historic duty and historic responsibility for all of us."


Stating that they considered the process important but that some criticisms also needed to be raised, Ahmet Türk recalled that the PKK had laid down its arms and dissolved itself in accordance with the instructions of Abdullah Öcalan. However, he said that thousands of Kurds remained in prison solely because of their ideas. Ahmet Türk criticized the fact that, despite legislation approved in Parliament by 467 votes, the process was being monitored by the Ministry of National Defense, the National Intelligence Organization, and a commission chaired by Cevdet Yılmaz.


Ahmet Türk said: "Let us consider it normal, for the sake of argument, that such an observation group is formed for those who have silenced their weapons. But we struggle to understand the purpose of having this body monitor people who are in prison solely because of their ideas, people who have never held a weapon in their lives. These people have never carried a weapon, never gone to Qandil; they are …

title: Karakum: My son's right to medical treatment is being denied
content:
It has emerged that Emir Karakum, who has been held at Marmara No. 2 L-Type Prison for 2.5 months on the pretext of the NATO Summit, is also being denied his right to medical treatment. Speaking to ANF, Emir Karakum’s mother, Birsen Karakum, pointed out that her son, who has a serious spinal condition and needs surgery, has not had his request to be transferred to a hospital granted.


My son has been in jail for 2.5 months on the assumption that he would take part in a protest


Around 150 people, including students and lawyers, who were detained in the witch hunt launched under the pretext of the NATO Summit have been held in prisons for months unjustly and unlawfully. Birsen Karakum, the mother of Emir Karakum, one of those detained, summarized the extent of the “enemy law” being applied against opposition groups by saying: “My son Emir was detained on June 23 and arbitrarily imprisoned on June 26, on the assumption that he would take part in a protest ahead of the NATO Summit. He has been held arbitrarily at Marmara No. 2 L-Type Prison for 2.5 months based on this assumption.”


Pointing out that her son’s right to medical treatment is also being denied in addition to his loss of freedom, Karakum said: “Emir has a serious condition affecting his spinal cord. He normally lives with us in Samsun, but he used to travel to Istanbul frequently for treatment. Most recently, he needed to undergo surgery, but ahead of the NATO Summit he was detained on June 23 solely on the assumption that he would take part in a protest, and on June 26 he was imprisoned without any questioning.”


Request to be transferred to hospital denied


Karakum pointed out that her son’s requests to be transferred to a hospital for treatment have repeatedly been denied, saying: “Even before Emir was imprisoned, when he was at home, he was suffering severe pain and could not stay still. We were constantly applying ice to ease his pain. His condition was serious. But now it has gotten even worse in prison because he cannot receive treatment. He keeps submitting petition after petition asking to go to the hospital, but his request is never granted. Since I also have health problems, Emir normally does not tell me everything over the phone so as not to worry me, but this time he explicitly said that his treatment was being prevented. Even though he submitted a petition to see a neurosurgeon in prison, they have not transferred him to the hospital.”


Karakum said that her son Emir had also been unlawfully imprisoned in 2021, and that he went on a two-month hunger strike at Samsun Bafra T-Type Prison against the isolation conditions imposed there. She said that torture involving his hands being cuffed behind his back caused tears in his shoulders.


Karakum stated that, despite the years that have passed, the tears in her son’s shoulders have not healed and that, on the contrary, he has now also begun experiencing pain in his spine. She said: “My child needs treatment now. He needs to be under a doctor’s supervision. But just as he is being held inside despite being innocent, he is also being denied treatment. There is no indication of how long this unlawful situation will continue. When he was outside, he was the voice and advocate of his friends who were on hunger strike against the isolation conditions in underground-type prisons. I believe that, under the pretext of the NATO Summit, what they are really trying to do is punish and criminalize this solidarity. My son, after all, would not even hurt an ant. He stands against all kinds of injustice and has always stood on the side of what is right. If he had committed a crime, I would say, ‘He committed this crime, so let him serve his sentence.’ But why should he be oppressed there when he is innocent? Why should his freedom be restricted? Why should he be deprived of his treatment?”


My son should be released


Emphasizing that her son’s imprisonment has negatively affected the entire family, Karakum said: “My son was our hands and feet. He was the one who took me to the doctor, and he was also the one who took care of everything for us. By subjecting him to this unlawful treatment, they are wearing him down as well as his family. We are all emotionally exhausted. I am exhausted. Every day I wake up from the same dream; I constantly dream of Emir knocking on the door and saying, ‘Mom, I’m home.’ I am deeply saddened by this situation. title: KCK: Damascus government should refrain from approaches that will also harm itself
content:
The Co-Presidency of the KCK Executive Council issued a statement about the killing of Sipan Hiznî and the fire in Kobanê.


The statement said: “We extend our condolences to the families of Sipan Hiznî, who was killed in Hesekê, and our nine people who lost their lives after burning to death in the prison in Kobanê; we wish the injured a speedy recovery.”


The statement added: “The Rojava Revolution and the Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria were attacked on February 6, 2026, by forces of the HTS-dominated interim administration in Syria as part of an international plan. In response to this attack, Leader Apo called for the peaceful resolution of problems within the framework of the democratic integration policy he had proposed for all countries of the region, particularly Turkey. Following this call, an agreement was reached between the interim Damascus government and the Autonomous Administration. Leader Apo had previously also provided a perspective for resolving problems on the basis of democratizing Syria. He repeatedly conveyed to the Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria that this perspective could be achieved through democratic integration. Integration must take place on the basis of democratization. The democratic aspect of integration is achieved by recognizing all different identities as equal and free.”


The Co-Presidency of the KCK Executive Council continued: “For months, the Autonomous Administration has both held talks with the Damascus government for democratic integration and waged a social struggle on this issue. However, it appears that problems have recently emerged regarding democratic integration. While a people’s education in their mother tongue should be beyond debate, efforts are being made to prevent the mother-tongue education that has been provided for 14 years in Rojava and areas where Kurds live. Serious efforts are being made to restrict education in Kurdish. This attack on 14 years of education demonstrates that the interim Damascus government does not genuinely want to recognize the existence of the Kurds. In this way, a religious version of Ba’athist nationalism is being imposed.


Our people and young people have been standing up against this for days. They have demonstrated that they will defend their right to education in their mother tongue. The organized strength of the Kurdish people will ensure that education in the mother tongue continues. The people and students say that education in our mother tongue is our red line. Saying, ‘It was never taught during the Ba’ath era,’ is nothing more than demagoguery. Comparing the situation with the Ba’ath regime creates, from the outset, the basis for restricting the Kurdish people’s free and democratic life. Our people have also shown that they will not accept such games.”


The statement underlined that “democratic integration begins, above all, with accepting local democracy and the will of the local population. The latest events in Kobanê have shown that the interim Damascus government rejects the local will. The approach of trying to resolve locally solvable problems by sending forces from Damascus and Aleppo essentially means continuing the governing culture of Ba’athist rule.


This approach by the interim Damascus government has been met with opposition not only from the Rojava and Syrian Kurdish people, but also from the Kurds in all four parts of Kurdistan and Kurds around the world. The DEM Party has described the intervention in Kobanê as a provocation aimed at the democratic integration process. The fact that the Kurdish population in Rojava and Syria is smaller than in the other parts of Kurdistan does not mean that they are without support or that they will accept this attack.”


The KCK added that “the Kurds in Rojava and Syria are Kurds who have carried out a democratic revolution. This revolution has given them awareness, will and organization. Our people can repel all kinds of attacks by demonstrating this strength through democratic actions. Democratization and fundamental democratic rights cannot be protected or won by simply waiting for them to be granted! In this regard, our people can exercise their democratic rights within the bounds of legitimacy. The stance taken by the people and students in support of education in their mother tongue is an important example of exercising their democratic rights. It is very important to develop democratic social organization widely and in depth …

author: Unknown
title: KNK: Tensions in Rojava must stop, independent investigation must be conducted
content:
The Executive Council of the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) issued a statement regarding the killing of Sîpan Hiznî, a fighter with the Hesekê Brigade, and the subsequent events in Kobanê, which resulted in the deaths of eight people and injuries to 18 others. The KNK called for an open, independent and impartial investigation to be conducted in order to establish all aspects of what happened.


The statement by the KNK Executive Council said that “the killing of Sîpan Hiznî, a fighter with the Hesekê Brigade, and the sharing on social media of footage showing the brutal manner in which the murder was carried out by the perpetrators have caused great shock and anger among our people.


Popular demonstrations were held in many cities and districts of Rojava Kurdistan. Those taking part in the demonstrations condemned the brutal incident and demanded that justice be served and those responsible be held accountable.”


The KNK added: “As part of these events, what happened in Kobanê — including the pursuit and detention of some demonstrators by forces affiliated with Damascus and Turkey-backed groups and attempts to take them to Aleppo Prison, followed by the incidents at and around Kobanê Prison that resulted in eight deaths and 18 injuries — is an extremely dangerous development, particularly given the condition of the wounded, some of whom are in serious condition.


This situation requires an immediate halt to the escalation, the assumption of serious responsibility, and an open, independent and impartial investigation to establish the events in full, identify those responsible, and ensure that everyone confirmed to have participated in the incident is held accountable.


We wish all the wounded good health and a speedy recovery; we offer our condolences to the families of the martyrs and to our people.”


The KNK continued: “At the same time, we call on our people to remain calm, exercise the utmost care and responsibility, protect public and private property, and not allow anger to turn into chaos, destruction or internal conflict. Holding demonstrations and expressing opposition is a legitimate right; however, chaos is not a solution. Protecting people and property is a shared responsibility.


We also call on all relevant government and security forces to fully assume their responsibilities in addressing the causes of the tensions, moving away from the current impositions, and preventing further escalation; to refrain from provocations and the use of force; to engage with the people of the region on the basis of responsibility and respect; and to establish serious channels of dialogue to resolve the underlying causes of the tensions.


We call on elders, community figures, Kurdish parties and those responsible in the region to play their genuine roles and contribute to calming and containing the tensions and preserving social peace.”


Finally, the KNK underlined that “we are all currently at a sensitive stage that requires everyone to put forward a language of reason and understanding. Provocations, impulsive reactions and being dragged into chaos and violence must be avoided; everyone seeking to exploit the atmosphere of anger to undermine the security and peace of society must be prevented from doing so.


For this reason, we once again reiterate our call for all the facts to be brought to light and for everyone confirmed to be responsible for crimes and violations to be held accountable.


We call on all sides to remain calm, exercise self-control, preserve social peace, protect public and private property, and place the public interest above all other considerations.”

author: Unknown
title: Mıhçı: ‘Bearing the burden of peace’ matters most now - Part Two
content:
Murat Mıhçı is a member of the Central Executive Board of the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party). In the second part of this interview, he stressed the need to strengthen Parliament’s capacity to develop policy and said the appointment of trustees to local authorities also represented a serious obstacle to democratisation.


The first part of this interview can be read

here

. 


Reversing the brain drain would strengthen Turkey


Mıhçı said democratisation could help bring skilled people back to Turkey, drawing attention to the country’s brain drain. He said strengthening the ties between people living abroad and Turkey would be important both economically and democratically:


Mıhçı also said: “Working conditions have not been created in institutions where qualified people can put their skills to use, and as a result we see that intellectual life and scientific development have failed to advance in many areas. Just think of how many highly skilled people have left this region. In the countries where they now live, they also serve, in a sense, as representatives of this region. Democratisation could encourage some of those people to return, while building links between the projects they are involved in abroad and Turkey would make an important contribution to the country’s economy, democratisation and development. I wish we could build such a bridge and establish peace together. I hope there is an opportunity to make this happen. I do not know whether the government and the state will seize this opportunity. But if it is to become a genuine possibility, I believe that peoples, faith communities and all sections of society, not only politicians, must voice this demand strongly.”


Democratic civil society organisations have been pushed to the brink


Mıhçı said pressure on civil society was one of the major obstacles to democratic politics in Turkey, arguing that democratic civil society organisations had been rendered increasingly ineffective.


He stressed the need to strengthen Parliament’s capacity to develop policy and said the appointment of trustees to local authorities also represented a serious obstacle to democratisation.


Mıhçı said: “We can see just how serious the situation is. We discuss and criticise the state of Parliament today, including its limited political influence. But an even clearer reflection of the problem can be seen in democratic civil society organisations, many of which have been pushed to the brink as a result of sustained pressure. Civil society organisations aligned with political interests have been created, while many others, particularly trade unions, are no longer able to fulfil their actual functions. This is one of Turkey’s most important problems. Ensuring that these organisations can operate and supporting their work is therefore extremely important. It is equally important to create an environment in which Parliament can genuinely develop policy and practise democratic politics. The fact that MPs, particularly those from the governing parties, cannot even influence decisions that fall outside their own political positions shows how constrained even government politicians have become, let alone the opposition.”


Trustee appointments and anti-democratic practices must end


Mıhçı said the appointment of trustees to local authorities should end, along with discriminatory practices affecting people dismissed by decree and the Academics for Peace. He also stressed that municipalities should have equal access to public resources.


Mıhçı continued: “The pressure on local government, particularly the continuing practice of appointing trustees, raises genuine concerns that laws may remain no more than words on paper. Creating a democratic environment would allow many issues, including the framework law, to move forward. Municipalities currently do not receive resources on an equal basis. Ending anti-democratic practices affecting municipal employees, including those dismissed by decree in the past and the Academics for Peace, would be a concrete democratic step and would demonstrate that change to society. That would be significant.”


Lasting peace requires strong public demand


Mıhçı drew attention to Turkey’s position in the Middle East and stressed the importance of strengthening the country’s democratic structures amid developments across the region.

title: Koma Amara releases new album ‘Hevala Min’
content:
Koma Amara has released its new album Hevala Min, dedicated to the Martyrs of Kurdistan Freedom.


Produced in collaboration between Awazgeha Delîla and Jê Muzik, the eight-song album includes ‘Derwêşo’, ‘Sara û Bîşeng’, ‘Vengê Avzem’, ‘Hevala Min’, ‘Çar Heval’, ‘Roniyê Me’, ‘Roj û Zarok’ and ‘Kezî’.


Xwezan Harun, a member of the Movement for Culture and Art (TEV-ÇAND) who contributed to the production of the album and wrote the song ‘Hevala Min’, spoke to ANF about the project.


We must keep the memories of our martyred comrades alive


Xwezan Harun greeted the people, listeners and his comrades and spoke about the process of preparing the album. 


Harun said: “We had been working on our album Hevala Min for some time, and now we have reached the end of that process. We are sharing the album with our listeners. As is known, the martyrdom of comrades whom we knew personally, fought alongside on the front and worked with has recently been announced. We extend our condolences to all the families of the martyrs and bow with respect before their memory. Most of the songs on our album were prepared for our martyred comrades. We shared many memories together; they were wonderful comrades, but sadly they have left us and reached the truth. We must keep their memories alive. Although these songs can never be enough, we hope through them to remember our comrades and keep their memory alive.”


Hevala Min was written for comrade Şoreş


Harun also spoke about the making of the album and writing ‘Hevala Min’, saying the album featured works by both members of the group and other artists.


Xwezan Harun said: “A great deal of work went into this album. Alongside comrades Ferîde and Pelşîn from the group, songs by our comrade Mazlum Awaz are also included. They wrote songs about martyred comrades with whom they had shared their lives. They also wrote lyrics about women on the path to freedom.


The song ‘Hevala Min’ on the album was written for comrade Şoreş. Şoreş Semsûr was a member of Koma Amara. We worked together for years and shared many wonderful times. He was martyred in a Turkish state air strike in the Medya Defence Zones in 2019. The martyrdom of comrade Şoreş deeply saddened all of us. I was one of the members of the group who had spent the most time with him. For that reason, my longing for comrade Şoreş and the meaning of the memories we shared were especially profound for me.”


Harun described how ‘Hevala Min’ came into being, saying that he wrote the lyrics and music at the same time.


Harun also said: “When an artist writes a song, they may choose a subject and need to spend time working on it. But with ‘Hevala Min’, I sat down and was able to write both the music and the lyrics in one sitting, almost as if comrade Şoreş had been waiting for the song.


We hope that ‘Hevala Min’ and the other songs on the album have found a place in your hearts. Once again, we commemorate all our martyred comrades, including those whose martyrdom was announced earlier and those announced recently, and we send our greetings and love to their families.”


Produced in collaboration between Awazgeha Delîla and Jê Muzik, the Hevala Min album features eight songs: Derwêşo, Sara û Bîşeng, Vengê Avzem, Hevala Min, Çar Heval, Roniyê Me, Roj û Zarok, Kezî’

author: David Swanson
title: The Cost of Arms Deals and Corruption in Cameroon
content:
Africa, Cameroon Chapter, Chapters, Economic Cost, Stop Arms Trade

By Guy Feugap, Africa Organizer for World BEYOND War, Corruption Tracker, September 13, 2026

When corruption scandals erupt in the arms trade, attention focuses on the millions embezzled, the officials implicated, and the ensuing legal proceedings. Yet the true cost of these cases often runs much deeper. Behind opaque contracts and illicit commissions lie consequences that directly affect governance, citizens’ trust in their institutions, and, above all, the security of the population. The Defex case, which brought to light corrupt practices in arms contracts between Spain and Cameroon, offers an opportunity to question a security model based on the accumulation of weapons. The Cameroonian case shows that corruption in the arms trade undermines public finances and jeopardizes human security; it thus raises a fundamental question: Can lasting peace truly be built on the foundations of militarism?

In the arms deals between Spain and Cameroon, a financial scandal has implicated high-ranking officials in the Cameroonian government, as documented by Corruption Tracker, which released the report Defex’s Dirty Decades: Arms Sales to Cameroon in September 2025. The Defex affair, portrayed as an international corruption scandal, goes beyond the scope of mere financial fraud to illustrate the abuses that can arise from relying on weapons to ensure human security. Defex S.A. was a company majority-owned by the Spanish government, tasked with promoting exports of defense and security equipment. Between 1999 and 2013, it entered into a series of contracts with the Cameroonian government worth at least 103 million euros for the supply of ships, military vehicles, coastal surveillance systems, radars, riot control equipment, bulletproof vests, small arms, and ammunition. According to investigations conducted by Spanish authorities, these contracts were facilitated by a system of kickbacks, through a network of shell companies through which more than 14.6 million euros allegedly passed under the guise of consulting services in order to pay intermediaries and fund kickbacks intended for several public officials.

The case led to a wide-ranging investigation by the Spanish anti-corruption prosecutor’s office, which began in 2014 and was later expanded to include several countries where Defex operated. The company was dissolved in 2017 and liquidated in 2022. In 2023, a Spanish court convicted Defex’s former sales director, Manuel Iglesias-Sarriá, as well as the head of Aresa Marine, of corruption in international business transactions. Cameroonian journalist Mimi Mefo reports that in 2023, Cameroon’s Special Criminal Court sentenced former Minister of Defense Edgard Alaij Mebe Ngo’o to 30 years in prison after finding him guilty of overbilling military equipment contracts totaling 23.9 billion CFA (about 36.4 million euros). He was charged with embezzlement of public funds, aggravated money laundering, and corruption. The Defex case highlights that defense contracts are a hotbed of corruption due to the secrecy surrounding them and the substantial sums of money involved. We therefore aim to understand, by examining the situation in Cameroon, how these practices affect public governance, citizens’ trust, and the security of the population.

Since 2012, Cameroon has been operating in a severely deteriorated security environment. The country is simultaneously facing several armed and humanitarian crises: the Boko Haram insurgency in the Far North Region, the armed conflict in the Northwest and Southwest Regions, the consequences of persistent instability in the neighboring Central African Republic, as well as growing challenges related to cross-border crime and forced population displacement. This accumulation of crises has profoundly transformed the government’s priorities, making security one of the main areas of public intervention. Since the early 2010s, Cameroon’s military spending has risen sharply as a result of operations, making security one of the government’s largest areas of expenditure.

The quantifiable impact of these crises is constantly evolving. The report Gender Conflict Analysis in Cameroon (2020) by WILPF Cameroon highlights that these conflicts have gradually plunged Cameroon into a situation of chronic violence, characterized by a rise in human rights violations, a decline in trust between citizens and public institutions, and a deepening of …

author: La Conquista del Panda
title: I Am Not Your Negro (2016)
content:
In 1979, James Baldwin wrote a letter to his literary agent describing his next project, "Remember This House." The book was to be a revolutionary, personal account of the lives and assassinations of three of his close friends: Medgar Evers, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King, Jr. At the time of Baldwin's death in 1987, he left behind only 30 completed pages of this manuscript. Filmmaker Raoul Peck envisions the book James Baldwin never finished.


I Am Not Your Negro is a 2016 documentary film and social critique film essay directed by Raoul Peck, based on James Baldwin's unfinished manuscript Remember This House. Narrated by actor Samuel L. Jackson, the film explores the history of racism in the United States through Baldwin's recollections of civil rights movement leaders such as Medgar Evers, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King Jr., as well as his personal observations of American history. The documentary was nominated for Best Documentary Feature at the 89th Academy Awards and won the BAFTA Award for Best Documentary.

title: Εν όψει της αποφυλάκισης του Νίκου Μαζιώτη, η Πόλα Ρούπα γράφει: Ποιός είναι ο τρομοκράτης;
content:
ΠΟΙΟΣ ΕΙΝΑΙ Ο ΤΡΟΜΟΚΡΑΤΗΣ;


Στις 14 Σεπτεμβρίου ο σύντροφος Νίκος Μαζιώτης θα αποφυλακιστεί έχοντας εκτίσει το σύνολο της ποινής που του έχει επιβληθεί. Επτά δικαστικά συμβούλια είχαν απορρίψει τα αιτήματά του για αποφυλάκιση με όρους ζητώντας του δηλώσεις μετανοίας, τις οποίες φυσικά, ποτέ δεν έκανε.


Ο σύντροφος δημοσιοποίησε ένα κείμενο για το γεγονός της αποφυλάκισής του, δηλώνοντας και δημόσια ότι δεν έχει μετανιώσει για τη συμμετοχή του στον Επαναστατικό Αγώνα και δεν έχει αποκηρύξει τη δράση του. Αρκετοί δημοσιογράφοι που αναπαρήγαγαν το γεγονός της αποφυλάκισης και το κείμενο του συντρόφου, δήλωναν έκπληκτοι επειδή παραμένει αμετανόητος.


Τι ακριβώς περίμεναν και τι ακριβώς περιμένουν αυτοί που εκφράζουν έκπληξη για τις δηλώσεις που έκανε ο σύντροφος μέσα από το κείμενο που δημοσιοποίησε; Τι περιμένουν οι δικαστές, οι καθεστωτικοί πολιτικοί και ορισμένοι δημοσιογράφοι από ένα συνειδητοποιημένο πολιτικό κρατούμενο; Ότι μια παρατεταμένη όσο δεν πάει φυλακή, θα τον κάνει να αλλάξει πολιτικά πιστεύω, να αποκηρύξει τις πολιτικές επιλογές αγώνα που έχει κάνει και θα δηλώσει υποστηρικτής του πολιτικού και οικονομικού συστήματος εξουσίας για να αποφυλακιστεί;


Ενώ τα προηγούμενα χρόνια –από την περίοδο έναρξης της δράσης του Επαναστατικού Αγώνα και τα χρόνια που ακολούθησαν το ξέσπασμα της μεγάλης οικονομικής κρίσης στη χώρα και τα “μνημόνια”– τα περισσότερα ειδησεογραφικά μέσα είχαν απαλείψει από το λεξιλόγιό τους τις λέξεις “τρομοκράτης” και “τρομοκρατική οργάνωση” όταν μιλούσαν για τον Επαναστατικό Αγώνα και εμάς, εν όψει της αποφυλάκισης του συντρόφου οι όροι αυτοί επανέρχονται με ιδιαίτερη έμφαση. Προφανώς για να δηλώσουν τη μεγάλη αφοσίωση των υπογραφόντων στο καθεστώς εξουσίας, καθώς το καθεστωτικό πολιτικό φάσμα ανεξαιρέτως κινείται τα τελευταία χρόνια όλο και πιο δεξιά και οι κοινωνικές αντιστάσεις αντιμετωπίζονται ως “απειλή για την κοινωνική ομαλότητα”.


Μάλλον πρέπει να επαναλάβω τα βασικά και τα αυτονόητα για την συντριπτική πλειοψηφία της κοινωνίας, την οποία το πολιτικό σύστημα εξουσίας ευελπιστεί ότι θα χειραγωγήσει.


Ο Επαναστατικός Αγώνας δεν ήταν τρομοκρατική οργάνωση και η κοινωνική βάση ποτέ δεν είδε τη δράση του ως απειλή ούτε τρομοκρατήθηκε από τις ενέργειές του. Αντιθέτως, η συγκεκριμένη επαναστατική οργάνωση έχει μείνει στην πολιτική ιστορία των αντιστάσεων αυτού του τόπου και έχει χαραχτεί στις κοινωνικές συνειδήσεις ως μια οργάνωση που δρούσε πλάι και αλληλέγγυα στον λαό, που αγωνιζόταν για τα συμφέροντα των κοινωνικά αδύναμων.


Ας θυμηθούμε τα βασικά. Ποια είναι η πραγματική τρομοκρατία για τις χαμηλές κοινωνικές τάξεις; Ποια είναι αυτά που προκαλούν τρόμο στην καθημερινότητα εκατομμυρίων ανθρώπων σε αυτή τη χώρα;


Τρομοκρατία είναι να δουλεύεις σαν σκλάβος μια, δυο ακόμα και τρεις δουλειές και να μην μπορείς να εξασφαλίσεις ούτε τα βασικά. Τρομοκρατία είναι να πηγαίνεις για το μεροκάματο και να μην ξέρεις αν θα επιστρέψεις στο σπίτι σου ζωντανός ή νεκρός.


Τρομοκρατία είναι να σου κλέβει το κράτος και οι πολυεθνικές τον πενιχρό σου μισθό. Να μην μπορείς να εξασφαλίσεις μια κανονική διατροφή για σένα και την οικογένειά σου. Να σου κλέβουν οι τράπεζες τα πάντα για τα δάνεια που έχεις πάρει και στο τέλος να σε πετάνε στις εταιρείες-κοράκια του χρέους για να σου πάρουν το σπίτι. Τρομοκρατία είναι να γυρνάς από τη δουλειά και να μην ξέρεις αν το κλειδί σου θα ανοίξει την πόρτα ή αν θα σε έχουν πετάξει στο δρόμο.


Τρομοκρατία είναι η αστεγία, η μόνιμη πλέον απειλή που κρέμεται πάνω από εκατομμύρια ανθρώπους γιατί η πολιτική εξουσία σε αγαστή συνεργασία με το μεγάλο κεφάλαιο αποφάσισε και μετέτρεψε τη στέγη στο πιο προσφιλές εμπόρευμα για τις εταιρείες real astate, με αποτέλεσμα τα νοίκια να ρουφάνε ολόκληρους μισθούς. Μέσα από ένα τρομοκρατικό και ληστρικό σχέδιο του κράτους και της κυβέρνησης έχουν εκτοξευτεί μέσα σε λίγα χρόνια τα νοίκια και η αξιοπρεπής στέγαση έχει γίνει είδος πολυτελείας.


Τρομοκρατία είναι η διάλυση της κοινωνίας, η εξάλειψη της κοινωνικής και ταξικής αλληλεγγύης, ο κοινωνικός κανιβαλισμός που περνάνε οι πολιτικές του κράτους και του κεφαλαίου με τις κυρίαρχες αρχές να σου λένε πως “ο καθένας είναι μόνος του”, “μόνο οι ισχυροί επιβιώνουν”, “το κέρδος και ο πλουτισμός είναι νόμιμος και ηθικός”. author: groundxero
title: The Victory of Equal Earth Over an Unequal One
content:
The blatant distortions of the Mercator projection and its Eurocentric approach gave rise to several alternatives, particularly among broad-left or progressive cartographers. Fianlly, the

United Nations General Assembly adopted an African proposal

 for a new world map, which shows countries’ true size relative to one another.


 


By

Prabir Purkayastha


Source:

 Globetrotter


 


Last week, on 4th September, the

United Nations General Assembly adopted an African proposal

 for a new world map, which shows countries’ true size relative to one another. It aims to correct the view of the world shaped by the widely used world map based on the Mercator Projection, created by Gerardus Mercator, a 16th-century Flemish cartographer. The problem with the Mercator Map is well known; for example, it shows the island of Greenland as the same size as the African continent, even though Africa is

14 times

 the size of Greenland! Simply put, Mercator maps greatly exaggerate the global north—the US and Europe—while shrinking Africa and most of Asia. Nor does it treat the rest of the Southern Hemisphere kindly. South America, nearly three times the size of Europe, looks comparable to it on a typical Mercator map.


 


Though there is no geographical reason the Southern Hemisphere should be smaller than the Northern Hemisphere, mapmakers made it significantly smaller because it had very little landmass beyond 40 degrees and was therefore cropped out. This meant that on most Mercator maps, because Western mapmakers cropped out much of the Southern Hemisphere, the equator was significantly displaced downward. The double whammy of squeezing the equatorial areas, where much of Africa lies, and shifting the equator down made the global north, particularly Europe and North America, seem much larger than they actually are. Typically, on most Mercator maps, the Northern Hemisphere looks

twice

 the size of the Southern Hemisphere, though the two hemispheres are identical in size.


 


Any map, whether Mercator or any other projection, has the problem that you can be true to either size or shape, but not both. The problem is a fundamental one of projecting a three-dimensional surface to a two-dimensional piece of paper. There is no way of doing this without distortions. Only a globe can truly represent the three-dimensional earth faithfully. But then what do we do when we want to reproduce geographical details for our readers in books or articles?


 


The blatant distortions of the Mercator projection and its Eurocentric approach gave rise to several alternatives, particularly among broad-left or progressive cartographers. Others, particularly in the US and Europe have opposed it, arguing that size does not matter and that they were comfortable being shown much bigger than they actually are. But many dissented and tried to work out alternate projections. The Gall-Peterson projection, which was backed by the German social democratic government of Willy Brandt, is one such projection. The Hobo Dyer projection, which is in the global commons, meaning anybody can use it without paying royalties, is another one. Finally, the

United Nations has ended the map wars

,

 with a resounding victory for the motion moved by the African nations for using equal area maps. The voting was 164 in favour of the motion with the US casting the only nay vote.


 


The objective of Mercator map was for ships navigating in open seas, where we can no longer navigate recognising various topological features, rivers, hills, villages, towns, etc. On the open ocean, if we identify where we are on a Mercator map and the destination we want to reach, we can travel in a straight line, as shown on the map. It conserves direction, meaning if we plot a course on a Mercator map, we can set our course by it. That is why ocean-going countries used Mercator projections for navigation when they had few instruments beyond the compass and the sextant to determine where they were relative to their destination.


 


It is important to note that the direction shown on the map is not the shortest path between where you start from and your destination. The shortest path on two points on the

surface of the globe

 is the arc of the great circle from where you are to your destination. A straight line on a 2-dimensional map may look like the shortest distance, but it is not as it does not account for the Earth’s curvature.

title: No extradition! Gericht entscheidet über Auslieferung des Antifaschisten Zaid
content:
No extradition! Gericht entscheidet über Auslieferung des Antifaschisten Zaid


Am 16. September 2026 wird das Berufungsgericht in Paris über das ungarische Auslieferungsersuchen gegen den Nürnberger Zaid entscheiden. Dem Antifaschisten, der im sogenannten Budapest-Komplex beschuldigt und mit europäischem Haftbefehl verfolgt wird, drohen in Ungarn bis zu 24 Jahre Haft unter unmenschlichen Bedingungen. Die französische Justiz hat bei den vorangegangenen Terminen schwere Bedenken geäußert, weil in Budapest ein rechtsstaatlichen Verfahren unwahrscheinlich und Folter zu befürchten ist. Dennoch ist nicht auszuschließen, dass das Pariser Gericht einer Auslieferung zustimmt.

Zaid wird zusammen mit anderen Antifaschist*innen im Budapest-Komplex vorgeworfen, sich im Februar 2023 an körperlichen Auseinandersetzungen mit Nazis beteiligt zu haben. Die Vorfälle ereigneten sich am Rand der antifaschistischen Proteste gegen den „Tag der Ehre“, das größte europäische Nazi-Vernetzungstreffen mit

NS

-verherrlichendem Aufmarsch, das jedes Jahr in Budapest stattfindet. Die ungarischen und deutschen Behörden nahmen die Auseinandersetzungen zum Anlass für eine gewaltige Repressionswelle gegen die antifaschistische Bewegung: Die Beschuldigten, von denen die meisten aus Deutschland kommen, werden mit Öffentlichkeitsfahndung, Verhaftungen, offen politischer Justiz und hohen Haftstrafen verfolgt. In Ungarn drohen ihnen sogar bis zu 24 Jahre Kerkerhaft.

Deshalb tauchten im Februar 2023 viele Gesuchte unter, doch knapp zwei Jahre später stellten sich Zaid und weitere Antifaschist*innen selbstbestimmt den deutschen Behörden. Seine Mitstreiter*innen, die die deutsche Staatsangehörigkeit haben, stehen seit dem Winter im Budapest-Großprozess in Düsseldorf und im Dresdner Antifa-Mammutprozess vor Gericht. Weil der Nürnberger einen syrischen Pass hat, lehnte die Bundesanwaltschaft eine Anklage in Deutschland ab und bedrohte ihn mit der Auslieferung an Ungarn oder der Abschiebung nach Syrien. Dass die deutschen Behörden keinerlei Hemmungen haben, Antifaschist*innen menschenunwürdigen Verfolgungen preiszugeben, ist durch Maja aus Jena allzu offensichtlich geworden: Die non-binäre Person wurde im Sommer 2024 in einem offenen Rechtsbruch über die Grenze verschleppt und sitzt seither unter folterähnlichen Bedingungen in ungarischer Haft.

Ende September 2025 floh Zaid nach Frankreich und stellte sich dort den Behörden in der Hoffnung, Schutz und Achtung seiner Grundrechte zu erhalten. Tatsächlich hatte die Pariser Justiz im Fall des ebenfalls beschuldigten Antifaschisten Gino im April 2025 eine klare Entscheidung getroffen: Unter Verweis auf die dortige katastrophale 

Menschenrechtssituation und fehlende Rechtsstaatlichkeit unter Viktor Orbán hatte das Berufungsgericht im Frühjahr 2025 abgelehnt, Gino an Ungarn auszuliefern. Allerdings stimmte dasselbe Gericht am 19. August 2026 dem deutschen Auslieferungsersuchen zu, denn die Bundesanwaltschaft kündigte nach dem vorigen Urteil an, Gino in Deutschland anklagen zu wollen. In Kürze ist mit einer zweitinstanzlichen Entscheidung in dieser Sache rechnen.

Im Fall von Zaid tagte das Pariser Berufungsgericht in den vergangenen Monaten bereits mehrfach und forderte jeweils weitere Informationen und Garantien aus Ungarn an. Beim Termin am 16. September 2026 um 16.00 Uhr ist mit einer Entscheidung zu rechnen, und nach dem jüngsten Urteil gegen Gino ist zu befürchten, dass sich Paris der internationalen Treibjagd gegen Antifaschist*innen anschließt. Vor allem in Frankreich finden zahlreiche Proteste gegen die drohenden Auslieferungen statt. Zu den bevorstehenden Gerichtsterminen wird zu Kundgebungen vor dem Justizgebäude und solidarischer Prozessbegleitung aufgerufen.

„Die internationale staatliche Verfolgung gegen Antifaschist*innen steuert derzeit auf immer neue Höhepunkte zu, und der Budapest-Komplex ist ein lehrbuchhaftes Beispiel für Rechtsbrüche am laufenden Band. Gerade das Terrorinstrument der Auslieferungen spielt eine ganz zentrale Rolle, um die beschuldigten Aktivist*innen einzuschüchtern und zu brechen“, erklärte Hartmut Brückner vom Bundesvorstand der Roten Hilfe e. V. „Umso wichtiger ist es, entschieden gegen die Auslieferungen vorzugehen. Antifaschist*innen in den Unrechts- und Folterstaat Ungarn zu überstellen ist ein fundamentaler Rechtsbruch. Wir fordern das Pariser Berufungsgericht auf, elementare Grund- und Menschenrechte zu respektieren und das Auslieferungsersuchen gegen Zaid entschieden …

author: Brian Hioe
title: Will There Be Corruption Cases in 2026 Elections?
content:
A NUMBER OF recent cases touch on questions of corruption ahead of the upcoming local elections. In particular, issues of corruption remain rife at the local level, and it is probable that there will be vote buying in the election–as occurs with any Taiwanese election.

New Taipei City Councilor Yang Chun-mei of the KMT has become the first politician to fall afoul of laws against vote buying, over accusations that she distributed laundry detergent and other household goods to voters. Campaign finance laws specify that the worth of goods distributed by politicians to voters cannot exceed a certain amount, as a result of which such goods usually consist of tissues, paper fans, and other low-value items.

Laundry detergent has, in fact, been among the goods distributed by politicians in the past in the form of laundry pods, memorably leading three to be hospitalized after mistaking the laundry pods for candy after a 2024 campaign rally by KMT presidential candidate Hou You-yi. But it appears that Yang distributed household goods in such quantity or otherwise promised financial reward to constituents in return for their votes so as to fall afoul of the law.

Yang is a four-time KMT city councilor representing Plains Indigenous. Though she has since been released on a 500,000 NTN bail, in addition to her, 21 individuals were questioned by prosecutors before the arrest.

Indeed, this also occurred with May Chin, an independent pan-Blue legislator who caucuses with the KMT. Most news reports have framed Chin’s recent arrest as over her embezzlement of legislative subsidies intended for hiring assistants–one of the most common forms of political corruption in Taiwan. Chin reportedly defrauded taxpayers of 7.87 million NT while also using Indigenous cultural associations to commit fraud by applying for government subsidies.

Chin would not be the only lawmaker accused of embezzling subsidies in a similar timeframe. DPP legislator Lin Tai-hua has been indicted over embezzling 13.79 million NT in campaign expenditures through falsifying invoices. Indeed, in past years, it has been controversial that legal changes passed by the KMT-controlled legislature no longer require invoices for some subsidies, making it easier for fraud involving embezzling subsidies.

At the same time, one notes that Chin was also found guilty of illegally importing COVID-19 tests from China during the COVID-19 pandemic. 74,400 unapproved COVID-19 tests were imported by Chin and her office head.

Though Chin claims that she meant to assist Indigenous communities using the COVID-19 tests, it is possible that she was provided the tests by the Chinese government. China has long faced allegations of being aided by Chinese United Front activities, so as to conduct outreach among Indigenous communities.

If such COVID-19 tests were a “campaign good” provided by China to boost China’s political campaigning, this would not be the first instance of a high-profile KMT politician facing accusations of being provided with free campaign goods by China. No less than KMT legislator caucus leader Fu Kun-chi has faced allegations of being provided “personal grooming kits”, by China, which Fu distributed to other KMT politicians for use as campaign merchandise. Offices linked to Fu were searched by prosecutors in response to such allegations in 2025, though Fu has claimed that the kits were worth only 20 NT, and not illegal.

author: Unknown
title: Fire at Kobanê Prison
content:
A fire broke out at the prison in the city of Kobanê in the early hours of the morning. According to initial reports, some prisoners lost their lives, while dozens of others were reportedly affected by smoke. The cause of the fire has not yet been determined.


ANHA reported that the fire broke out at Kobanê Prison around 2:00 a.m. In addition to those who lost their lives at the prison, which housed a large number of prisoners, some prisoners affected by smoke were also transferred to hospitals.


Prisoners affected by the smoke were taken to hospitals in Kobanê, while the cause of the fire remains unclear.


An investigation into the incident has been launched.

author: Unknown
title: Bartın: Society must take ownership of the peace process
content:
Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) MP Öznur Bartın assessed the Peace and Democratic Society Process, saying it could not be approached solely through the question of “which rights will be recognised”. She said discussions should also focus on what society can create with the resources available to it, which institutions it can develop and how it can build its own future.


The Peace and Democratic Society Process has also brought greater attention to how the Kurdish question is reflected in people’s everyday lives, beyond legal reforms and political decisions. Discussions are taking place across a wide range of areas, from language and education to science, local government, the economy, employment, and the organisation of women and young people.


Bartın said the debates and initiatives emerging through the process should not focus solely on steps expected from the state. She stressed the need to concentrate equally on what society itself can achieve in everyday life and the areas in which it can develop its own structures.


Bartın said the process should not be confined to high-level politics, negotiations or legislative reforms in Parliament, stressing that lasting peace would be possible only if people had a say in their own communities and strengthened their capacity for social organisation.


She said Kurdish society needed to develop its own institutions in the fields of language, culture, education, science, local democracy, the economy, employment, women and youth.


The question cannot be resolved through laws alone


Öznur Bartın said the state had a responsibility to take fundamental steps towards resolving the Kurdish question, including recognising the right to the mother tongue, expanding the space for democratic politics, respecting the will of local administrations and ensuring equal citizenship. She stressed, however, that an approach which places the entire responsibility for social life on the state would leave society in a passive position, waiting for change.


Bartın said: “The state has a role in this process and it has responsibilities. There are fundamental issues such as legal reforms, democratisation, freedom of expression and the expansion of political space. If we make the resolution of every problem dependent solely on steps taken by the state, society will be left waiting.


Society also needs to discuss and organise around what it wants in its own life: how people want to live, how they will use their own language, how they will keep their culture alive, how they will raise their children and how they will address problems in their own neighbourhoods.”


We must sustain the production of knowledge in Kurdish


Bartın said Kurdish should not be confined to mother-tongue education and cultural activities, stressing that legal guarantees were essential to enable the language to be used in fields such as education, science, technology and academia. She added that society could also use the resources already available to support work in these areas.


Bartın said more children’s books, educational and scientific materials, and digital content could be produced in Kurdish, while small study spaces could be created where young people could conduct research in their mother tongue.


She said initiatives such as establishing a small neighbourhood library, preparing educational materials through an association, bringing young people together in study groups or organising communal courses in subjects such as mathematics and physics could also make an important contribution.


Bartın stressed that ensuring Kurdish has a lasting place in everyday life could not be achieved simply by encouraging people to speak the language or through large-scale projects alone. She said a combination of small initiatives and social solidarity could strengthen Kurdish as a language of knowledge and intellectual production, laying the foundations for the future today.


The role of local government must be expanded


Öznur Bartın said the approach to local government also needed to change, arguing that municipalities should not be limited to providing roads, water and sanitation services. She said the resources available to cities could also be used to support education, science, culture, social life and employment.

content:
Vendredi 2 octobre à 19h30, Benedikte Zitouni sera à la librairie Le Monte en l'air pour présenter son livre Résister dans les milieux ravagés. Une fabrication d'héritages aux éditions Météores


Ce recueil de Benedikte Zitouni, sociologue, regroupe des textes à la fois militants et universitaires. Il propose des manières de pratiquer l'enquête «

 

avec

 

» des terrains, de façon située, visant à hériter des luttes des personnes concernées et à sortir du commentaire surplombant prétendument «

 

neutre

 

». Ces enquêtes s'intéressent aux archives des Young Lords, aux luttes écoféministes, ou encore au religieux dans l'activisme politique. author: Unknown
title: Ankara'da 'suç örgütü' operasyonunda 8 tutuklama
content:
Ankara'nın Keçiören ilçesinde pazar yerinde meydana gelen silahlı kavganın ardından başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında güvenlik kamerası görüntüleri incelendi. Görüntülerde bir grubun olay yerine bir araçla geldiği, ateş açtıktan sonra kaçtığı ve diğer grubun bir araçla kovaladığı görüldü. Kavga öncesi olay yerine keşfe geldiği tespit edilen otomobil bulunarak otoparka çektirildi.

Otomobildeki 4 şüpheli bulundukları eve düzenlenen operasyonla gözaltına alındı. Evde yapılan aramada 3 ayrı ruhsatsız tabanca ele geçirildi. Diğer gruptaki şüpheliler de tespit edilip gözaltına alındı. Adreslerde yapılan aramalarda 2 bin civarında sentetik uyuşturucu hap bulundu. Gözaltına alınanlardan birinin 10 yıl, bir diğerinin ise 4 yıl aranması olduğu ortaya çıktı.

Operasyonlarda gözaltına alınan 10 kişiden H.Y, B.A, E.G, S.S, A.E, F.G, E.Ş. ve M.T. 'silah ticareti', 'uyuşturucu ticareti' ve 'öldürmeye teşebbüs' suçlarından tutuklandı.

Olay yerinde bulunan kovanlar ve silahlar, balistik inceleme ve karşılaştırma için kriminal incelemeye gönderildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturması: Gazeteci Selahattin Günday dahil 3 kişi tutuklandı
content:
Eski Milli İstihbarat Teşkilatı (MİT) görevlisi Kaşif Kozinoğlu'nun ölümüne ilişkin yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında 10 Eylül Perşembe günü düzenlenen operasyonda gözaltına alınan 9 kişiden 3'ü tutuklandı, 6 kişi adli kontrolle serbest bırakıldı.

Ergenekon soruşturması kapsamında tutuklu bulunduğu Silivri Cezaevinde 2011 yılında hayatını kaybeden Kaşif Kozinoğlu'nun ölümüne ilişkin yürütülen soruşturma kapsamında düzenlenen ikinci dalga operasyonda aralarında 2 gazetecinin de bulunduğu 9 kişi gözaltına alındı. İstanbul İl Jandarma Komutanlığındaki ifade işlemleri tamamlanan 9 kişi Silivri Adliyesine sevk edildi.

Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturması: Gazeteci Selahattin Günday dahil 9 kişi gözaltına alındı

Savcılıktaki ifade işlemlerinin ardından hakimliğe sevk edilen isimlerden gazeteci Selahattin Günday ile acil tıp teknisyenleri (ATT) Özlem Uslu ve Emre Atmaca tutulandı. Hakimlik, doktor Turgay Tamer, kameraman İdris Tiftikci, ambulans şoförleri Ahmet Göksel Erdoğan ve Mahmut Arslan ile ATT personeli Tuba Koç ve Nesrin Kaya'nın adli kontrolle serbest bırakılmasına karar verdi.

Selahattin Günday kimdir? Kozinoğlu’nun kayıp mektubunu haberleştirmişti

Gazeteci Selahattin Günday, 2011 yılında Kozinoğlu'nun ölümünün hemen ardından, cezaevinde yazdığı ve sonrasında savcılığın el koyuğu belirtilen kayıp mektubu ilk kez haberleştiren gazeteciydi. Avukat Hüseyin Ersöz, Günday'ın bu soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınmasının kabul edilemez olduğunu belirterek, gözaltı kararına itiraz etmişti.

Gazeteci Selahattin Günday’ın gözaltına alınmasına itiraz edildi

Kaşif Kozinoğlu, 12 Kasım 2011'de tutulduğu Silivri 1 No'lu L Tipi Kapalı Ceza İnfaz Kurumundan Silivri Devlet Hastanesine sevk edilmiş ve burada hayatını kaybettiği tespit edilimişti. Olayla ilgili 10 Nisan 2012 tarihinde "kovuşturmaya yer olmadığı" kararı verilmişti.

Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek, geçtiğimiz günlerde Faili Meçhul Suçları Araştırma Daire Başkanlığınca dosyanın yeniden incelendiğini belirterek, "Silivri Sulh Ceza Hakimliğinin 26 Ağustos 2026 tarihli kararıyla takipsizlik kararı kaldırılmış ve soruşturma yeniden başlatılmıştır" açıklamasını yapmıştı.

Kozinoğlu'nun kesin ölüm sebebinin ve ölümünde üçüncü kişilerin müdahalesi bulunup bulunmadığının belirlenmesi amacıyla 15 yıl sonra, 12 Eylül'de mezarı açıldı.

Soruşturma kapsamında ilk dalga operasyonda, o dönem ceza infaz kurumunda görev yapan 10 kişi gözaltına alındı. O dönem jandarma er olarak görev yapan şüpheli tutuklanırken, 7’si adli kontrol şartıyla olmak üzere 9 kişi serbest bırakıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.
